jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
Hi, we are Swapfiets! 👋
We are on a mission to make cities more liveable by getting more people on bikes. To make sure our members can enjoy the ride, we take care of everything around their bike subscription.
Subscription Management is at the heart of that experience. Our systems manage the subscription lifecycle, including changes, pricing, billing, payments and cancellations. We are continuing to evolve this domain, complete our migration from the legacy platform and build a strong foundation for the future.
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help us make that happen. You will work on complex problems, build reliable software and have a visible impact on our members and our business.

What you will do:

Design, build and maintain backend services for Subscription Management.
Work on complex domain problems involving subscriptions, pricing, billing, payments and customer lifecycle changes.
Translate business needs into practical and maintainable technical solutions.
Take ownership of the systems you build in production, including monitoring, operational improvements and incident support.
Help evolve the architecture of Subscription Management to support future business requirements.
Identify risks, dependencies and inconsistencies in requirements, and communicate them early.
Collaborate with Product, Design, Data, Operations and other engineering teams.
Contribute to technical standards, design discussions and improvements to the way we work.
Support other engineers through mentoring, pairing and constructive code reviews.
Communicate important technical decisions through design documents, presentations and other suitable channels.

The gear you need:

Several years of professional experience building backend software.
Strong experience with C# and .NET.
Experience designing and building APIs and distributed systems.
Experience with relational databases, preferably Microsoft SQL Server.
A strong understanding of automated testing, CI/CD, observability and secure development.
Experience operating software in production and investigating incidents.
Experience working with Azure and Docker.
You have hands-on experience with AI-enabled engineering tools, or you are a strong enthusiast who actively explores their practical use.
You are eager to grow your AI skills and help colleagues grow theirs.
The ability to work independently on complex problems and make sound technical decisions.
Clear communication skills, both with technical and non-technical colleagues.
A pragmatic mindset: you care about quality and long-term maintainability, while also delivering value incrementally.
An interest in understanding complex business domains and improving them through software.

You do not need prior experience in the Subscription Management domain. We are looking for strong backend engineering skills and the ability to learn a complex business domain.

AI is already an important part of how we work at Swapfiets. You will collaborate with our strong AI team and use leading AI tools to improve how we build software and solve problems. You will also help colleagues discover and apply these tools effectively and responsibly.

Nice to have for the ride:

Experience with subscriptions, billing, invoicing, payments or Stripe.
Experience with financial data or reconciliation.
Experience with event-driven systems and asynchronous workflows.
Experience migrating from legacy systems to modern services.
Experience with infrastructure as code.

Benefits for a smooth ride:

Salary of up to €6,030 per month, excluding holiday pay.
Your own Swapfiets through our lease plan 🚲
32 vacation days: 25 regular vacation days plus 7 Swap days to use as you please.
A solid pension plan and a discount on your health insurance.
A MacBook or Windows laptop, whichever you prefer.
Lots of responsibility, challenging work and friendly colleagues.
Travel allowance if you live more than 11 km from the office.
Delicious lunch at the office for a small contribution.
OneFit for Business.
An education budget and learning programmes.
Workshops and inspirational talks.
One paid day per year for voluntary work.
Flexibility to work from home or from our office in Amsterdam.

Pedalling towards inclusivity at Swapfiets 🚲

At Swapfiets, we believe in the power of diversity and inclusion. We are committed to creating a workplace where people with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives feel welcome, valued and able to contribute. We know there is always room to improve, and we continue to work on making Swapfiets a more inclusive organisation.

Ready for the ride?

If you are excited about building reliable software, solving complex problems and helping shape the future of Subscription Management, we would love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Software Architect Microsoft (.Net & Azure)
jobs.description:
Bij Sogeti werk je als Software Architect Microsoft aan complexe IT-vraagstukken binnen een dynamische en kennisgedreven omgeving. Je bent onderdeel van een community van experts die elkaar versterken, uitdagen en inspireren. We geloven in vakmanschap, kennisdeling en plezier in het werk. Daarom organiseren we regelmatig technische meetups, deep-dive sessies en bieden we volop ruimte voor certificering en persoonlijke groei.

Jouw rol als Software Architect Microsoft

Als Software Architect ben jij de technische sparringpartner voor onze klanten en collega’s. Je ontwerpt en realiseert robuuste en schaalbare architecturen op basis van Microsoft-technologieën, .NET en Azure. Je vertaalt businessdoelen naar technische oplossingen en begeleidt ontwikkelteams in het maken van de juiste designkeuzes. Je werkt aan projecten bij toonaangevende organisaties binnen diverse branches, waarbij je continu schakelt tussen strategie, techniek en teamdynamiek. Je bent in staat om architectuurprincipes helder over te brengen, risico’s te identificeren en mitigaties voor te stellen. Je hebt een sterke visie op softwarekwaliteit, DevOps, cloud-native development en security-by-design. Dankzij jouw ervaring en overtuigingskracht weet je stakeholders mee te nemen in jouw technische keuzes.

Wie ben jij?

Je hebt een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding en minimaal 4 jaar ervaring als Software Architect.
Gedegen kennis van Microsoft-technologieën (.NET, Azure, DevOps, etc.)
Ervaring met het opzetten van softwarearchitecturen en het begeleiden van ontwikkelteams
Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en analytisch vermogen
Passie voor technologie en een drive om continu te leren en te verbeteren
Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal op minimaal C1-niveau.

Dit bieden wij jou

   Een dienstverband van 40 uur per week, met flexibele mogelijkheden om parttime te werken.
   Een salaris tussen de E80.000 en E95.000 bruto per jaar (inclusief vakantiegeld en mobiliteitsbudget), exclusief bonus.
   Een flexibel mobiliteitsbudget, met o.a. opties om elektrisch te rijden.
   Hybride werken en een goede werk-privébalans.
   Uitgebreide opleidings- en certificeringsmogelijkheden.
   Flexibiliteit in het ruilen van feestdagen, passend bij jouw persoonlijke voorkeuren.
   26 vakantiedagen per jaar, met de optie om extra dagen bij te kopen.
   Uitdagende projecten bij toonaangevende organisaties waarin jouw technische expertise het verschil maakt.
   Toegang tot onze kenniscommunity, meet-ups, hackathons en tech-events. En natuurlijk: ontspanning via game nights, skitrips en meer.

Ben jij nieuwsgierig geworden naar de projecten waar wij dagelijks aan werken en wil jij deel uitmaken van onze actieve Microsoft Community?
Solliciteer nu en ontdek hoe jij het verschil kunt maken! Een PES-screening en assessment maken deel uit van het proces.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
Over Zineps

Bij Zineps bouwen we de agentic layer of global logistics
Wij geloven dat iedere zending – van pakket tot pallet – uiteindelijk door één intelligente softwarelaag moet bewegen. Een platform waarin AI, automatisering en logistieke netwerken samenkomen om wereldwijd verzenden eenvoudiger, slimmer en schaalbaarder te maken.
Onze ambitie gaat verder dan software alleen: bij Zineps bouwen we de agentic layer of global logistics
– de laag waarin autonome AI-agents zelf verzendbeslissingen nemen, workflows orkestreren en de wereldwijde logistiek aansturen.
Vandaag helpen we duizenden e-commercebedrijven en logistieke partners met meer dan 60 carrier-integraties, labelautomatisering, realtime tracking en krachtige verzendworkflows. Maar dat is pas het begin.
Daarom zoeken we een hands-on Head of Engineering
die niet alleen de technische koers van het platform bepaalt, maar ook zelf blijft bouwen aan de fundering van een internationaal softwarebedrijf.

Jouw rol

Je bent een builder én een leider.
Je bepaalt de technische richting van Zineps, bouwt en laat het engineeringteam groeien, en blijft tegelijkertijd hands-on in de codebase. Je zet de standaard – technisch én cultureel – en je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor de architectuur, kwaliteit en schaalbaarheid van het platform.
Je krijgt veel vrijheid en eigenaarschap om technische keuzes te maken die jarenlang impact zullen hebben, in nauwe samenwerking met de founders.
Ongeveer:
50% software development (hands-on)
20% architectuur & technische keuzes
15% teamleiderschap, coaching & hiring
15% product- en engineeringstrategie

Wat je gaat doen

De technische visie en roadmap van Zineps bepalen en uitdragen
Zelf schaalbare software ontwerpen en bouwen in C# / .NET
Onze event-driven architectuur doorontwikkelen met Azure Functions, Service Bus en messaging
Meebouwen aan een AI-first platform waarin autonome agents en automatisering centraal staan
Het engineeringteam opbouwen, aannemen en laten groeien
Engineering standaarden bewaken via code reviews en technische begeleiding
Developers coachen en helpen groeien
Nieuwe technologieën onderzoeken en introduceren
Nauw samenwerken met Product om technische en functionele keuzes te maken
De engineeringcultuur van Zineps vormgeven

Technologie

C# · .NET · Blazor · React · Microsoft Azure · Azure Functions · Azure Service Bus · SQL Server · GitHub Actions · REST APIs · Event-driven architecture · AI integrations

Wie jij bent

Je hebt minimaal 8 jaar ervaring als software engineer, waarvan een deel in een lead-, senior- of leidinggevende rol. Je voelt je thuis in een omgeving waar snelheid, ownership en kwaliteit samenkomen, en je wilt een engineeringorganisatie vanaf de basis mee vormgeven.
Daarnaast herken je jezelf in het volgende:
Sterke kennis van C# / .NET
Ervaring met Microsoft Azure
Ervaring met het bouwen van schaalbare backend-systemen
Goede kennis van SQL Server
Ervaring met API-design
Bekend met CI/CD
Ervaring met het leiden, coachen of laten groeien van developers
Frontend-affiniteit (Blazor, React of vergelijkbaar) is mooi meegenomen
Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid en ownership
Je communiceert helder
Je denkt vanuit productimpact en niet alleen vanuit techniek
Je hebt geen 9-5 mentaliteit

Extra pluspunten

Ervaring met:
AI-productontwikkeling en agentic systemen
Event-driven systemen
Microservices
SaaS-platformen
E-commerce
Shipping of logistiek
Het opbouwen en schalen van engineeringteams

Wat wij bieden

Een sleutelrol als technisch leider binnen een snelgroeiende AI scale-up
Directe eigenaarschap over de technische koers van het platform
De kans om een engineeringorganisatie vanaf de basis op te bouwen
Veel ownership en weinig bureaucratie
Werken aan software die wereldwijd gebruikt wordt
Intensieve samenwerking met de founders
Een ambitieus engineeringteam dat kwaliteit voorop zet
Volledige reiskostenvergoeding
Werken vanuit ons kantoor in Amsterdam
Marktconform salaris passend bij ervaring, impact en ownership
Veel ruimte om door te groeien richting VP Engineering of CTO naarmate Zineps schaalt
Wij geloven dat de mensen die Zineps helpen bouwen, ook moeten kunnen meedelen in het succes ervan. Daarom kunnen medewerkers die zich onderscheiden door impact, ownership en langdurige betrokkenheid in aanmerking komen voor ons Employee Stock Option Program (ESOP).

Waarom Zineps?

Bij Zineps bouw je niet aan de zoveelste SaaS-tool. Je bouwt aan de agentic layer of global logistics
– de infrastructuur achter de volgende generatie wereldwijde e-commerce.
We geloven dat AI een fundamentele rol gaat spelen in logistiek, en we bouwen vandaag aan het platform dat daar de basis voor vormt. Als jij energie krijgt van complexe technische uitdagingen, een team wilt opbouwen, ownership wilt nemen en zichtbaar impact wilt maken binnen een klein, ambitieus team, dan komen we graag met je in contact.

Klaar om mee te bouwen?

Stuur je CV of LinkedIn-profiel, eventueel aangevuld met een korte motivatie, naar khoos@zineps.com.
Let's build the agentic layer of global logistics. Together.

English:
About Zineps

At Zineps, we're building the agentic layer of global logistics
We believe that every shipment-from parcels to pallets-should ultimately move through a single intelligent software layer. A platform where AI, automation, and logistics networks come together to make global shipping smarter, simpler, and more scalable.
Our ambition goes beyond software alone: at Zineps, we're building the agentic layer of global logistics
—the layer where autonomous AI agents make shipping decisions, orchestrate workflows, and drive global logistics on their own.
Today, we help thousands of e-commerce businesses and logistics partners streamline their shipping operations through 60+ carrier integrations, automated label generation, real-time tracking, and powerful shipping workflows. But this is only the beginning.
That's why we're looking for a hands-on Head of Engineering
who doesn't just define the technical direction of the platform-but keeps building its foundation alongside the team.
Your Role

You're a builder and a leader.
You set the technical direction of Zineps, build and grow the engineering team, and stay hands-on in the codebase. You set the standard—technically and culturally—and you own the architecture, quality, and scalability of the platform.
You'll have the freedom and ownership to make technical decisions that will have a lasting impact, working in close collaboration with the founders.
Your time will roughly be divided into:
50% Hands-on software development
20% Architecture & technical decision-making
15% Team leadership, coaching & hiring
15% Product & engineering strategy

What You'll Do

Define and drive the technical vision and roadmap for Zineps
Design and build scalable software yourself using C# / .NET
Further develop our event-driven architecture using Azure Functions, Service Bus, and messaging
Help build an AI-first platform where autonomous agents and automation are at the core
Build, hire, and grow the engineering team
Maintain high engineering standards through code reviews and technical guidance
Mentor developers and help them grow
Research and introduce new technologies where appropriate
Work closely with Product to shape both functional and technical decisions
Shape the engineering culture at Zineps

Technology Stack

C# · .NET · Blazor · React · Microsoft Azure · Azure Functions · Azure Service Bus · SQL Server · GitHub Actions · REST APIs · Event-driven architecture · AI integrations
Who You Are

You have 8+ years of experience as a software engineer, including time in a lead, senior, or leadership role. You thrive in an environment where speed, ownership, and quality go hand in hand, and you want to shape an engineering organization from the ground up.
You also have:
Strong knowledge of C# / .NET
Experience with Microsoft Azure
Experience building scalable backend systems
Solid SQL Server knowledge
Experience designing REST APIs
Experience with CI/CD pipelines
Experience leading, coaching, or growing developers
Frontend affinity (Blazor, React, or similar) is a plus
A strong sense of ownership and responsibility
Excellent communication skills
The ability to think beyond code and focus on product impact
A builder's mindset—you don't have a 9-to-5 mentality

Nice to Have

Experience with:
AI product development and agentic systems
Event-driven systems
Microservices
SaaS platforms
E-commerce
Shipping or logistics
Building and scaling engineering teams

What We Offer

A key technical leadership role within a fast-growing AI scale-up
Direct ownership of the technical direction of our platform
The opportunity to build an engineering organization from the ground up
High ownership with minimal bureaucracy
The opportunity to build software used around the world
Close collaboration with the founders
An ambitious engineering team that values quality, speed, and ownership
Full travel reimbursement
Office-based role in Amsterdam
Competitive salary based on experience, impact, and ownership
Excellent growth opportunities toward VP Engineering or CTO as Zineps scales
We believe in rewarding long-term builders. Outstanding performers who demonstrate ownership and make a significant impact may become eligible for our employee stock option program (ESOP), allowing them to share in the long-term success of Zineps.

Why Zineps?

At Zineps, you're not building just another SaaS product. You're building the agentic layer of global logistics-
the infrastructure behind the next generation of global commerce.
We believe AI will fundamentally reshape the logistics industry, and we're building the platform that will power that transformation. If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, want to build a team, take real ownership, and see your work make visible impact within an ambitious team, we'd love to hear from you.
Ready to Build the Future?

Send your CV or LinkedIn profile-optionally with a short introduction-to khoos@zineps.com.
Let's build the agentic layer of global logistics. Together.

The company develops an innovative SaaS platform for the real estate sector, enabling real estate professionals to digitally manage and optimize their processes. The scalable product is used daily by more than 350 customers (In private & public sectors) in the real estate industry.

The international engineering team currently consists of 11 professionals and is entering an important next phase: transitioning from one team into two, and potentially three autonomous, cross-functional teams. Supporting organizational change and continuous improvement.

8+ years of experience in software engineering.

A hands-on mindset (approximately 50% management / 50% technical).
Strong communication skills in English and the ability to connect technology, product and business.

Hybrid working environment in Utrecht.
Salary up to 120k (Including Holiday Allowance)

jobs.title: Technical QA Engineer
jobs.description:
Want to shape how quality is built, not just catch bugs at the end? As our Technical QA Engineer, you'll take our test automation to the next level. Your work helps municipalities keep children in school, get students safely to class, and protect local families from debt.

About the role

Joining two agile teams on a modern Symfony/PHP stack, you won’t be expected to have a complete strategy figured out on day one. You will start hands-on integrating CI/CD quality gates and optimising tests. As you establish these foundations, you will step up to take full ownership of the broader testing strategy.
After six months;
Hotfixes are rare, because critical issues are caught upstream in design and automated pipelines.
Fast, reliable test suites run automatically, giving developers instant feedback on their changes.
Developers actively write better integration tests and collaborate on test design as part of their standard workflow.

Your responsibilities

Analyse early. Review designs and user stories with the team, assess risks, and make sure acceptance criteria are clear and testable before coding starts.
Automate smartly. Build fast, reliable full-stack automation (API, integration, E2E).
Integrate pipelines. Drive CI/CD test gates using modern, AI-assisted tooling.
Coach and elevate. Partner with developers and product owners to elevate testing practices (TDD/BDD) across teams.
Learn from what breaks. Use hotfixes and metrics (flakiness, coverage, defect trends) to fix underlying processes, not just individual bugs.
Safeguard. Implement automated checks for WCAG accessibility and audit secure coding standards.

About you

Experience: 3+ years in technical QA, with a clear drive to step up into strategy ownership.
Technical chops: Clean, maintainable test code in a modern scripting/OOP language (we use PHP, but solid architecture matters more than the specific stack).
Analytical mindset: Skilled at dissecting complex system behaviour, reviewing specs, and diagnosing root causes.
Mentor: Help developers grow, leading by example, and making quality concepts clear to everyone.
Basics: Bachelor’s/Master’s level (HBO/WO) or equivalent experience, good command of English and interest in learning Dutch.

Submitting a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG) is required as part of our onboarding process.

Nice-to-haves

Experience with testing frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, PHPUnit, Pest, or Codeception.
Hands-on experience with CI/CD platforms (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
Experience with WCAG / EN 301 549 accessibility audits or basic security testing.
QA certifications such as TMap or ISTQB.

What we offer

A close-knit, enthusiastic team of professionals who actively support one another.
High autonomy and ownership: flexibility in how you manage your work, backed by supportive leadership.
Hybrid work model: freedom to work remotely, combined with two set office days for collaboration and team events.
Continuous growth opportunities through the xxllnc Academy for personal and professional development.
A competitive compensation package including salary, mobility allowance, laptop, phone stipend, and home-office allowance.
Engaging team events and social activities.

jobs.title: IoT / DevOps Engineer - Home Energy Management
jobs.description:
Good to know: you can easily save this vacancy using the print button at the top of the page. After the closing date, this vacancy will be removed from our website.

You build the platform that connects and steers home batteries, solar panels, EVs and charge points across thousands of Dutch homes.
You work with modern cloud technology: TypeScript, Azure, event-driven services and Infrastructure as Code.
Your work helps households use their own green energy at the right moment, instead of letting it go to waste.

Why choose Eneco?

At Eneco we work towards one clear goal: being fully climate-neutral by 2035. A big part of that happens at home. Solar panels, batteries, electric cars and heat pumps only make a real difference if they work together and respond to the moment when green energy is available.

That is what our Home Energy Management platform does. It is the enabling layer other Eneco teams and products build on: it connects the assets in someone's home, talks to the systems of the manufacturers behind them, and makes it possible to control them safely and reliably. You build that layer, in a team that takes engineering seriously and gives you room to shape how it grows.

What You’ll Do

You build and run cloud-native services on Azure, using Functions, IoT Hub, Event Hubs and API Management.
You design and build event-driven integrations and REST APIs that other teams use.
You build backends for our mobile apps, so customers can see and steer their own energy at home.
You build integrations with OEMs and vendors, from battery manufacturers to charging-station suppliers, and you deal with the reality that every partner does things a little differently.
You automate your infrastructure with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC: your environment is defined in code, not clicked together by hand).
You keep quality high with CI/CD, automated tests, monitoring and observability.

Is this about you?

You have solid engineering fundamentals and you care about writing code that others can build on.
You work with TypeScript and Node.js, or you're a strong developer in another modern language and happy to switch.
You feel at home in the cloud. Azure is a plus; experience with AWS or GCP translates well.
You understand event-driven architecture and APIs, and you like building systems that stay reliable when things go wrong.
You're curious about new technology and you take ownership of what you build, from first commit to production.
You want to work on energy solutions for consumers and you find that motivating.
Recognise yourself in most of this, but not every requirement? We'd still love to hear from you.

You’ll be responsible for

Reliable services and integrations that connect and control energy assets in customers' homes.
APIs and events that other Eneco teams can build on with confidence.
Automated, repeatable deployments through Terraform and CI/CD.
The health of what you build: you run it, you monitor it, you improve it ("you build it, you run it").

This is where you’ll work

You join the engineering team behind Home Energy Management. The team builds an enabling platform for the wider Eneco ecosystem, so you work closely with product, mobile teams and external partners. It's a hands-on team that shares knowledge, discusses architecture together and leaves plenty of space for your own ideas.

What We Have To Offer

Gross annual salary between €69,000 and €100,000 Including FlexBudget, 8% holiday allowance, and depending on your role a bonus or collective profit sharing.
FlexBudget Have it paid out, use it to buy extra holiday days or save it up for something nice, it's up to you.
Personal and professional growth Eneco is fully committed to help you in your personal and professional development.
Hybrid working: home, office or abroad Work 40% at the office, 40% from home, and 20% flexibly. With manager approval, you may work abroad (within approved countries) up to 3 weeks/year, max 2 consecutively.

Want more information about our terms of employment?

Here's what you get from us

Work Where Everyone Matters

When you choose a career at Eneco, you choose ambition, growth, and opportunity in an environment where everyone matters. You’re given the space to develop yourself and to do your work in a way that suits you. We believe that different perspectives, nationalities, and backgrounds make us stronger, which is why we foster an open, safe and inclusive culture. Naturally, we also prioritize a healthy work-life balance, flexible working hours, and the option to work from home when your role allows it. If you have a physical or sensory disability, we will work with you to find the right adjustments so you can perform your job well.

This is how you build your own future and a sustainable future at the same time. Together with 4,000 colleagues, each with their own talents and ideas, you work on our shared mission: speeding up the energy transition. We help customers become more sustainable faster, create innovative solutions, and seize new opportunities. Will you join us?

The phases of our application procedure

Want to know more about this job function?

With this job vacancy, we aim to recruit a new colleague for Eneco. Therefore, this is not a solicitation for acquisition.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect, CustomerLake
jobs.description:
Marketing teams are stuck between fragmented customer data and martech stacks that copy that data into proprietary silos while customers expect real-time, personalized experiences. Customer Lake, the agentic Customer Data Platform (CDP) built natively into Databricks, changes that equation. It unifies first- and third-party data into governed Customer 360 profiles, resolves identities, and uses agents to build audiences, recommend next-best actions, and activate campaigns across channels, all without copying data out of the Lakehouse or adding vendor lock-in.

The Solutions Architect (Customer Lake) team is part of a dedicated, global go-to-market organization focused on driving adoption and revenue growth for Customer Lake, Databricks’ agentic Customer Data Platform (CDP) built natively into the Data Intelligence Platform. The Customer Lake SA will engage clients across business units and verticals, build relationships with marketing and data stakeholders, position Customer Lake in depth, and deliver presentations, demos, and POCs that drive informed adoption decisions. They will understand the guardrails and the steps needed to successfully land and expand Customer Lake as clients deliver on their customer engagement and growth objectives.

The impact you will have

Provide technical leadership to guide strategic customers to successful implementations on customer data and marketing projects, ranging from architectural design to data engineering to identity resolution, audience activation, and agent deployment
Collaborate with GTM leadership and account teams to design and execute high-impact engagement strategies across your territory, driving Customer Lake adoption from initial Customer 360 build-out through full CDP augmentation or replacement.
As a trusted advisor, serve as an expert Solutions Architect building technical credibility with CMOs, heads of marketing technology (MarTech), data engineering leaders, and marketing and analytics teams to drive product adoption and vision.
Enable clients at scale through workshops, POC execution, and developing customer-facing collateral that increases technical knowledge and demonstrates the value of an embedded, agentic CDP architecture.
Influence product roadmap by translating field-derived, data-driven insights into strategic recommendations for Product and Engineering teams.
Handle the most complex technical challenges in this product line by acting as the tier-3 escalation point for the field, ensuring customer success in mission-critical, customer-facing data environments.
Establish and refine the sales qualification and POC intake process, ensuring well-scoped engagements that maximize customer success and minimize friction for R&D.

Competencies & Responsibilities

5+ years of customer data platform (CDP), marketing technology (MarTech), or customer data engineering expertise, with a proven track record of designing and delivering client-facing customer data and activation solutions (of which 3+ years are in a customer-facing, pre-sales or consulting role).
Experience with design and implementation of data and AI applications for marketing and customer engagement, including identity resolution, segmentation, personalization and next-best-action, and agentic AI workflows for audience building and campaign activation.
Deep familiarity with CDP and martech/adtech platforms, including composable-CDP architectures (Salesforce Data Cloud, Adobe, Segment, Treasure Data, Braze, or similar), including implementation, identity resolution, audience activation, and migration strategies.
Strong understanding of the customer data landscape: first-party data (web, app, CRM, POS), third-party and enrichment data, identity graphs, consent and privacy signals, and martech/adtech destinations (ad platforms, email/SMS, CRM, and analytics tools).
Experience operationalizing customer data as governed data products, including audience and segment definition in SQL or natural language (Genie), reverse-ETL and activation pipelines, and metric, identity, and consent governance in Unity Catalog.
Experience collaborating with Global System Integrators (GSIs) and third-party consulting organizations to drive customer outcomes in marketing and customer data initiatives.
Hands-on experience building solutions within major public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP), with an understanding of cloud-native data ingestion, activation, and governance.
Undergraduate degree (or higher) in a technical field such as Computer Science, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Engineering or similar.
Proficiency in Spark / Pyspark

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

Benefits

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

Compliance

erwartet dich ein Umfeld, in dem technische Exzellenz, stabile Plattformen und moderne Engineering‑Standards den Unterschied machen. Du arbeitest datenbasiert, wertorientiert und eng mit Tech, Design und den Fachbereichen zusammen.

Du entwickelst und betreibst Backend-Anwendungen
auf Basis von C# und .NET

.

.

.

zur Weiterentwicklung des Produkts ein.
Du behältst das große Ganze im Blick
, verstehst die Zusammenhänge zwischen Business und Technologie und findest pragmatische Lösungen
.

durch Tests, Code-Reviews und nachhaltige Architekturentscheidungen sicher.
Du bringst deine Erfahrung aktiv ins Team ein und unterstützt Kolleg:innen als Sparringspartner:in
.

in der Entwicklung von Webanwendungen mit C# / .NET
.
Sehr gute Kenntnisse in C# / .NET
, relationalen Datenbanken (z. B. MS SQL) und API-Schnittstellen.
Erfahrung in produktnahen Entwicklungsumgebungen
mit komplexen fachlichen Anforderungen
.

.
Du möchtest fachliche Herausforderungen verstehen und lösen
, anstatt ausschließlich Tickets abzuarbeiten.
Erfahrung mit agilen Entwicklungsmethoden
sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern.

ist für dich ein fester Bestandteil guter Softwareentwicklung (Unit-, Integrations- und E2E-Systemtests).

und sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1)
in Wort und Schrift.
Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung, denkst "outside the box"
und bringst eigene Ideen proaktiv ein.
Du entwickelst dich selbstständig und aktiv weiter und arbeitest dich aktiv in die Nutzung von KI
ein.

Das bekommst du von uns

Feelgood
: Veranstaltungen, wie Teamevents, Sommerfest und regelmäßige Offsites stärken den Team-Zusammenhalt und stellen einen standortübergreifenden Austausch sicher.
Feedback & Kommunikation
: Wir gehen auf Mitarbeitenden-Bedürfnisse durch regelmäßige Gespräche im 1:1, anonyme Mitarbeitendenbefragungen und das jährliche Kultur-Feedback ein.
Office-Benefits
: In unseren Büros gibt es höhenverstellbare Tische, Sitzbälle, kostenfreie Getränke & Snacks und vieles mehr. Du kannst sogar deinen Hund mitbringen.

On top

Staff Backend Engineer – Platform

Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech

Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay.

If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you.

About the role

You'll join our Platform team as an individual contributor working closely with our Principal Engineer, who leads Platform's technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering org, so this is a high-ownership seat: you'll take on large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives and drive them from first analysis through to completion, with real autonomy over how you get there.

We don't run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a big topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn't the role; if you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you'll fit right in.

What you'll be up to

Architecting and developing scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems.
Self-identifying and scoping problems and initiatives, not just executing assigned tickets: assessing impact, prioritisation and timing independently.
Leading architectural decisions and design discussions with cross-team alignment.
Driving large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, including coordination with multiple stakeholders.
Mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence.
Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that empower teams to deliver faster and more reliably.
Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available.
Participating in on-call rotations and stepping in as a reliable problem solver during incidents.
Proactively spotting where AI and automation can drive technical improvement.

Some of the challenges waiting for you

Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database (we already scale reads horizontally).
Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery.
Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform, including the ability to recreate an Apaleo environment from scratch.
Extracting and reworking common services (like shared schedulers) to get us ready for our next scale level.

What you'll bring to the team

8+ years of backend development experience, including several years in a staff-level or technical leadership role.
Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms: we care more about how you think than which stack you've used.
A track record of owning large technical initiatives from ambiguity through to completion, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team.
Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals with genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well).
Comfortable working with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack).
Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests: we don't have a dedicated QA function.
Fluent English.

Nice to have

Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS/Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong.
Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other IaC approaches (like CloudFormation).
Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus experience is a good transferable equivalent).
Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Amazon CodeWhisperer) and a genuine interest in AI-driven engineering improvement.
Excellent collaboration and communication skills, particularly for introducing new technology, like AI tooling, to other teams.

What we offer

Culture and growth

A diverse and international team: work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities.
Growth and development: 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and an evolving career framework.
Autonomy and ownership: we empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly in an environment built on trust and transparency.
Shape the future of hospitality tech: your work drives real impact from day one, at a fast-growing scale-up.
Competitive and fair compensation, guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams.

Perks and lifestyle

Flexible and remote work options: office, home or hybrid, based on what works for your role and team.
A fully covered Deutschland Ticket for free public transport across Germany.
Regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties and other offsite events.
30 days of paid holiday to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired.
An EGYM Wellpass membership giving access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options.

Where you'll work from

This role is based in Munich, with hybrid working from our office there. We're also open to remote within Germany, or remote via an Employer of Record for candidates based outside in the EU/ Europe.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer, committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive and welcoming workplace. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. jobs.title: Manager, Tax Technology — VAT (Wolt & Deliveroo Tax Platform & Business Projects)
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About The Team

We are looking for an experienced Manager, Tax Technology to lead tax platform projects for Wolt and Deliveroo within our growing Tax Team. As Wolt and Deliveroo onboard onto the global unified tax platform and a single tax calculation engine (Vertex), this role owns the functional tax leadership that turns business and VAT requirements into configured, tested, live capabilities, and leads the offshore Wolt & Deliveroo implementation team delivering that work day to day. As DoorDash continues to grow its international footprint, we are looking for a candidate with deep, hands-on experience in VAT regimes who can lead a team, collaborate cross-functionally, and own the delivery of tax features and new-platform feature / new-market / new-partnership launches across Wolt and Deliveroo.

About The Role

You will report to the Senior Manager of the Tax Calculation Platform & Mx Operations and lead tax platform and business projects for Wolt and Deliveroo. You will manage a team to deliver day-to-day VAT configuration and testing, and partner closely with Tax Engineering, the Wolt and Deliveroo Tax teams, Tax Product, and other stakeholders — gathering business and VAT requirements, translating them into tax-system functional requirements for configuration and testing, and reviewing Technical Design Documents (TDDs) to provide functional tax expertise back to Tax Engineering.

The primary focus of this position is end-to-end delivery of VAT tax solutions across the Wolt and Deliveroo platforms — new product, market, partnership launches and legislative changes, roadmap alignment with Wolt and Deliveroo's international expansion, and day-to-day leadership of the team executing that delivery — with an understanding of how data flows from upstream systems through the tax engine to downstream reporting. Rather than handing off requirements to the Vertex Center of Excellence team, you will apply your own Vertex knowledge to help influence the functional design and determine the specific Vertex configuration a solution requires. Familiarity with US sales and use tax, food and beverage, and retail tax context is valuable for alignment with the broader platform.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

Lead tax platform and business projects across the Wolt and Deliveroo platforms, including new product, market, partnership launches, and legislative changes.
Gather business and VAT requirements and translate them into tax-system functional requirements for configuration, testing and delivery.
Review BRDs, PRDs, and TDDs for VAT tax-system implications and provide functional tax expertise back to Tax Engineering.
Define testing requirements and oversee validations across unit, integration, E2E, shadow, and post-launch phases.
Align tax engine priorities and the integrated delivery plan with the Wolt and Deliveroo international market roadmaps, and represent tax platform status updates to Tax and Engineering leadership.
Trace VAT-relevant data from upstream systems through Vertex to downstream reporting and compliance.
Serve as the senior functional tax leader for Wolt and Deliveroo, escalating risk and driving cross-functional alignment across Tax, Product, Engineering, and Data.
Manage and develop a team supporting this area, allocating workload, establishing QA checkpoints, and providing structured knowledge transfer on complex processes.

We’re excited about you because…

You have 8+ years of indirect tax or indirect tax technology experience, with several years working directly in VAT regimes.
You are familiar with VAT tax requirements and can translate them into system requirements.
Hands-on experience implementing or configuring Vertex O Series, and ability to review Vertex configurations and testing documentation and provide feedback.
Hand-on experience implementing or configuring ERP tax integration (e.g. Netsuite) with Vertex tax engine.
Experience with multi-country VAT implementations and EU VAT compliance; familiarity with non-US indirect tax regimes more broadly is a plus.
Demonstrated people-leadership experience, including managing, coaching, workload delegation, and quality oversight.
You can review technical design documents and provide functional tax expertise to engineering and product.
You have familiarity with US sales and use tax, food and beverage, and retail tax context.
You understand how tax data flows from upstream transaction systems through a tax engine to downstream reporting, including both in-house systems or ERP system integration flows.
Program or project management experience across dependent teams, including building plans, milestones, and dependency maps, and driving them to completion.
Comfort operating cross-functionally and building trust with partner teams without always holding formal authority over their roadmaps.
Experience in use of SQL or Snowflake for data self-serve, issue investigation or testing validation.
Experience in use of API testing tools like Postman, SOAP UI and ability to read XML and JSON logs.
Accounting, Finance, Information Technology, or Computer Science degree.
You are fluent in leveraging multiple AI tools on the market (e.g., Claude Cowork, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor) on a daily basis across all of your assigned tasks, and you actively look for creative ways to apply them to enhance processes and create efficiency gains.

Nice to Haves

Familiarity with Marketplace Facilitator laws.
Experience managing offshore teams across time zones.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

jobs.title: Distributed Systems Engineer 4/5 - Cloud Platform Infrastructure Engineering Tooling
jobs.description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

Netflix has been changing how people watch shows and movies, enabling on-demand access to thousands of movies and TV shows. Recently, Netflix has expanded its entertainment offering to include Live content, like the Jake Paul vs. Mike Tyson match, the NFL Christmas Games, Beyonce's halftime show, the SAG Awards ceremony, and more. Bringing stories in real time to 300+ million viewers around the world is a hard challenge, demanding exceptional levels of scaling, reliability, stability, and operational excellence across our Cloud Platform stack.

About The Team

Cloud Infrastructure Engineering (CIE) builds and operates the foundational platform that Netflix runs on — compute, storage, networking, and performance infrastructure, at global scale. We think of ourselves as platform engineers for infrastructure: building the systems, tools, and abstractions that let Netflix's engineering organization move fast without compromising reliability or efficiency.

We are building the Cloud Infrastructure Tooling team in Warsaw — a new team that will sit at the center of CIE, acting as a multiplier across compute, storage, networking, and performance teams.
The charter is to build internal tooling, developer-facing UIs, and shared services that reduce duplication and let CIE's domain teams to increase velocity. The problems we'll solve are technically challenging: our customers will be some of the most demanding infrastructure engineers in the industry, and the systems they depend on run at Netflix scale.

If you want to understand the kind of engineering this team supports, explore:

Auto Scaling Production Services on Titus
Noisy Neighbor Detection with eBPF
Region Evacuation Reimagined
Evolving Region Evacuation
Consistent caching mechanism in Titus Gateway
Mount Mayhem at Netflix: Scaling Containers on Modern CPUs

What You Will Do

Design, build, and operate software solutions and tooling that serve CIE's compute, storage, networking, and performance engineering teams — the engineers who run Netflix's cloud infrastructure.
Solving real business needs at a large scale by applying your software engineering and analytical problem-solving skills.
Building software solutions and tools to improve developer experience and product experience in collaboration with team members and stakeholders.
Architecting and building a robust, scalable, and highly available distributed infrastructure.
Responsible for driving alignment with stakeholders and setting partner expectations.
Leading cross-functional initiatives and collaborating with engineers, product managers, and TPM across teams.
Sharing our experiences with the open source communities and contributing to Netflix OSS.

What We Are Looking For

7 or more years of experience designing and building complex, scalable distributed data infrastructure
Proficiency in at least one of: Java, Go, or C++, with a strong software engineering foundation that enables you to write clean, maintainable, high-performance code.
Practical understanding of at least one infrastructure domain — compute, distributed storage, or cloud networking or performance.
Experience owning and delivering high-impact systems end-to-end, with accountability in dynamic and sometimes ambiguous environments.
Experience building and operating scalable, fault-tolerant, distributed systems

What Sets You Apart

Motivation to work on infrastructure that other engineers depend on, with a focus on building systems that are reliable and resilient.
Bringing a product mindset to internal tooling: you think about developer experience, adoption, and the real-world impact on the teams you serve.
Comfort with ambiguity and experience helping to shape problem definitions as well as solutions
Experience contributing to or engaging with open source infrastructure communities.
You approach technical challenges from first principles — you don't reach for familiar patterns when a better solution exists.

Want to know more about how we work at Netflix? You can read more about Netflix culture.

Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

Om företaget

Vår kund är ett internationellt teknikbolag med verksamhet och utveckling i Lund. Här utvecklas mjukvarulösningar inom bland annat fastighetsautomation, där data från olika system i byggnader samlas in, bearbetas och används för att ge bättre förståelse för byggnaders status och behov.
Utvecklingen sker i en internationell miljö med kollegor både i Sverige och på andra håll i världen. Teamen består av utvecklare tillsammans med kompetenser inom bland annat QA, DevOps och produktutveckling, och engelska används som arbetsspråk.

Verksamheten befinner sig i en expansiv fas där utvecklingsteamen får större ansvar och fler initiativ att arbeta med. Det innebär att man nu vill förstärka organisationen med flera nya utvecklare inom olika tekniska områden.

Detta är initialt ett konsultuppdrag där du anställs av Mero och arbetar som konsult hos vår kund, med möjlighet att på sikt övergå till en anställning direkt hos bolaget.

Om rollen

Som backendutvecklare blir du en del av utvecklingen av ett större systemlandskap där data från olika enheter och system i byggnader samlas in, skickas vidare och bearbetas i molnet. Det handlar om dataintensiva lösningar där stora mängder information behöver hanteras, struktureras och göras tillgänglig för andra delar av systemet och de webbapplikationer som användarna arbetar i.

Ditt arbete ligger framför allt i backend och kan omfatta olika delar av detta flöde - från lösningar nära de enheter som skickar data till de molnbaserade tjänster som tar emot och bearbetar informationen. Du arbetar med att vidareutveckla befintliga lösningar och funktionalitet, med C#/.NET eller Go som möjliga tekniska inriktningar. Azure är en del av teknikmiljön och du kommer även i kontakt med bland annat SQL och databaser.

Du blir en del av ett tvärfunktionellt team där utvecklare arbetar nära bland annat QA, DevOps och produktägare. Här finns inte alltid skarpa gränser mellan rollerna – utvecklarna arbetar exempelvis själva med automatiserade tester och delar av DevOps-arbetet. Parprogrammering, brainstorming och gemensam problemlösning är naturliga delar av arbetssättet, där du både tar ansvar för ditt eget arbete och bidrar till lösningen som helhet.

Om dig

Vi söker dig som har ett genuint intresse för utveckling och som tycker om att lösa tekniska problem tillsammans med andra. Du tar ansvar för det du arbetar med, driver ditt arbete framåt och är samtidigt bekväm med att involvera kollegor när det behövs.
För den här rollen är din praktiska utvecklingsförmåga viktigare än ett visst antal år i yrket. Du kan därför vara relativt tidigt i din karriär och ha byggt upp starka kunskaper genom exempelvis egna projekt eller studier, ha arbetat några år som utvecklare eller ha en längre erfarenhet inom området.

För rollen ser vi att du har:

Praktisk erfarenhet av backendutveckling
Erfarenhet av C#/.NET och/eller Go
God förståelse för modern mjukvaruutveckling
God kommunikativ förmåga på engelska

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:

Azure eller andra molnmiljöer
SQL, databaser och arbete med större datamängder
Testautomation och automatiserade tester
CI/CD, DevOps eller andra delar av leveransflödet
Funktionell programmering

Som person tror vi att du är nyfiken, ansvarstagande och samarbetsorienterad. Du uppskattar att sätta dig in i nya tekniska problem och trivs i en miljö där man delar kunskap, hjälper varandra och tillsammans tar ansvar för att hitta bra lösningar.

jobs.title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
Inriver is the AI-powered Product Information Management (PIM) platform that helps brands, manufacturers, and retailers turn product data into a growth engine. Inriver connects seamlessly to upstream systems and downstream channels, enabling continuous optimization of product experiences across every touchpoint, and is trusted by more than 1,600 global brands. Our customers — from B2B manufacturers to global retailers — rely on Inriver to manage massive, complex product catalogs and get them to market faster, with less manual rework.

About the role:

We are now looking for a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
to join our team in Malmo to lead technical engagements with our most strategic and complex customers. This is a role for someone who can walk into ambiguous, high-pressure enterprise environments and design the right solution — not just execute someone else's plan. This is a new role within our Engineering team, and we’re looking to hire two Senior Forward Deployed Engineers in Malmö and two in the US.

What you’ll do 💭

Own the technical architecture and delivery strategy for our largest and most complex customer engagements, from discovery through go-live and expansion
Act as the senior technical advisor to customer engineering and IT leadership — often CTOs, VPs of Digital, or Heads of Data — on how Inriver fits into their broader systems landscape
Design and build complex, high-leverage integrations and workflows on top of Inriver's platform, connecting it to ERP/PLM systems (SAP, Oracle, Dynamics), DAM, and downstream commerce/syndication channels
Model elastic, enterprise-scale product data structures (categories, attributes, relationships, localization) for customers with significant catalogue complexity or regulatory requirements
Lead rapid prototyping efforts to de-risk onboarding, migrations, and pilots for customers with the highest data volume or complexity
Write production-quality code - platform enhancements, connectors, extensions, internal tools — while also knowing when to bring in additional engineering support and how to scope that work
Mentor and technically guide other Forward Deployed Engineers, reviewing their solution designs and unblocking them on hard problems
Serve as a senior technical voice of the customer internally, shaping product and platform roadmap decisions based on patterns across strategic accounts
Own escalated production issues, leading real-time debugging efforts alongside customer engineering teams
Travel to customer sites as needed (expect :20–40% travel depending on account load)

What you’ll bring

We don’t expect you to tick every box - but we think you’ll succeed here if you have many of the below:

✔️7+ years of experience in software engineering, solutions engineering, or a related technical/customer-facing role, including experience owning complex technical engagements

✔️Strong hands-on coding skills in C#, with the judgment to know when to build vs. when to advise

✔️Extensive experience with REST/GraphQL APIs, webhooks, and enterprise integration patterns (ETL, middleware, iPaaS) at scale

✔️Track record of leading technical relationships with enterprise customers — comfortable being the senior voice in the room with customer executives

✔️Strong ability to reason about complex data models — attributes, taxonomies, relationships — and how they map to messy, real-world enterprise catalogues

✔️Experience mentoring or technically leading other engineers, even without formal management responsibility

✔️A bias toward action balanced with the judgment to architect for scale and maintainability, not just the immediate fix

✔️Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to translate fluidly between deep technical detail and executive-level strategy

✔️Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure) and modern deployment practices at enterprise scale

✔️High comfort with ambiguity and the ability to bring structure to messy, high-stakes customer environments

Nice to have:

Prior experience with a PIM, MDM, DAM, or product data platform
Deep experience integrating with ERP or PLM systems
Experience with ecommerce/marketplace syndication at scale
Familiarity with compliance-heavy product domains
Prior experience in a senior forward-deployed, solutions architecture, or professional services leadership role at an enterprise SaaS company
Experience contributing to pre-sales or solutioning for large enterprise deals

Why Inriver 💙

At Inriver, you’ll join a global company with a product at the centre - and people who genuinely care about building something meaningful together. For this role you will also have ownership of the most technically and strategically important customer relationships in the company, direct line of influence into product and platform roadmap decisions and a seat at the table with both customer executives and product leadership.

In our Malmö office, you’ll find things like:

Tuesday Fika☕
Friday breakfasts to start the day together
A running club and social activities for anyone who wants to join
A welcoming mix of focused work, collaboration, and a few laughs along the way

We work in a hybrid setup, with flexibility and trust as a baseline.

Ready to apply? 📬

We’d love to hear from you. If you’re curious but not 100% sure, we still encourage you to apply. We’re happy to explore the fit together!

Inriver is a global leader in Product Information Management (PIM), helping more than 1,600 brands create outstanding product experiences. Behind our success is a team of talented, collaborative, and passionate people who enjoy solving complex challenges and making an impact for customers around the world.

Headquartered in Malmö, Sweden, we have colleagues across multiple locations globally, bringing together diverse perspectives, expertise, and experiences. For more information, visit www.inriver.com or follow us on LinkedIn.

Kunden beskriver ett problem som egentligen inte har någon självklar lösning. Det är komplext, kanske lite rörigt och exakt den typen av utmaning du gillar.

Du börjar ställa frågor, koppla ihop saker, skissa på lösningar i huvudet och du vet att du inte behöver ha alla svar själv. Du har nämligen ett team bakom dig som tänker lika mycket som du och kompletterar dig i det du inte kan.

Det är så det är att jobba på Compago.

Vi bryr oss inte om din debiteringsgrad. Vi tänker inte börja mäta den heller.

Och vi tror inte på lönemodeller som stressar mer än de motiverar. Vi tror istället på balans, trygghet och att faktiskt ha ett hållbart arbetsliv (ja, på riktigt).

Det vi gillar? Kluriga projekt, samarbete och att lösa svåra problem tillsammans. Du är personen som vet att du inte kan allt, men som är rejält nyfiken på att lära dig mer och gärna delar med dig längs vägen.

Hos oss samarbetar vi i projektform åt stora bolag som gör skillnad. Du får grotta ner dig i Power Platform och andra Microsoft-tekniker, förstå kundens verksamhet och bygga smarta lösningar, som förmodligen inte gjorts tidigare och som faktiskt används.

Om du kommer från kundsidan eller konsult spelar ingen roll. Du trivs med att jobba i projektform, har praktisk erfarenhet av Microsoft-utveckling och en god förståelse för verksamhet. jobs.title: Infrastructure & Application Engineer
jobs.description:
Syneritys spännande resa fortsätter, och för att möta den ökande efterfrågan på vårt konsulterbjudande behöver vi nu stärka vårt team kopplat till HaloITSM. Därför vänder vi oss nu till dig som vill vara med att skapa fantastiska kundupplevelser inom IT & Enterprise Service Management (ITSM & ESM).

Om Synerity

Synerity föddes ur en övertygelse om vikten av att arbeta kundfokuserat och att enbart jobba med produkter som vi verkligen tror på och själva skulle välja om vi var kunden. I kombination med vår erfarenhet och kompetens baserar vi vårt erbjudande på lösningar som såväl vi själva som ledande analytiker som Gartner och Forrester anser ha en stark marknadsposition och goda framtidsutsikter. Några av produkterna vi arbetar med är Freshservice, Zendesk, HaloITSM, Atomicwork & Siit.

Synerity söker en erfaren teknisk konsult som vill hjälpa kunder att implementera och vidareutveckla våra lösningar i deras egna IT-miljöer

Hos Synerity arbetar vi med verksamhetskritiska IT-lösningar som installeras i våra kunders IT-miljöer, ofta on-premises. I den här rollen blir du länken mellan Syneritys produkter och kundens tekniska plattform. Fokus ligger på att förstå kundens miljö, identifiera tekniska förutsättningar och säkerställa att våra lösningar implementeras, integreras och fungerar enligt kundens behov.

Det här är en roll för dig som känner dig trygg i Windows Server, databaser, identitetshantering, integrationer och autentiseringslösningar, och som tycker om att kombinera teknik, problemlösning och kunddialog.

Du behöver inte vara expert på ITSM från början. Det viktigaste är att du har en god förståelse för Microsoft-baserade IT-miljöer och tycker om att sätta dig in i nya system och tekniska lösningar.

Om Rollen

Du kommer att arbeta med implementation, uppgraderingar, teknisk rådgivning och förvaltning av Syneritys lösningar hos våra kunder.
Arbetet sker i nära dialog med kundernas IT-avdelningar där du hjälper till att planera, konfigurera och kvalitetssäkra lösningar i deras befintliga miljöer.

Du kommer bland annat att:
Delta i förstudier och tekniska workshops inför nya implementationer.
Kartlägga kunders tekniska förutsättningar och ta fram lösningsdesign för installationer.
Installera och konfigurera Syneritys lösningar i kunders on-premises- eller hybridmiljöer.
Arbeta med Microsoft SQL Server och relaterade databaskomponenter.
Konfigurera integrationer mot Active Directory, Entra ID, e-postplattformar och andra verksamhetssystem.
Hantera autentisering, tjänstekonton, certifikat och behörigheter kopplade till våra lösningar.
Felsöka integrationer, systemfunktioner och tekniska fel tillsammans med kundens IT-organisation.
Genomföra uppgraderingar, migreringar och förändringar i befintliga installationer.
Dokumentera lösningsdesign, installationer och tekniska rekommendationer.
Delta i kundmöten och agera teknisk rådgivare kring arkitektur, säkerhet och integrationslösningar.
Samarbeta nära utvecklare, projektledare, konsulter och supportfunktioner för att säkerställa framgångsrika leveranser.

Du kommer ofta att vara den person som kunden vänder sig till när frågan är:
"Hur kan vi implementera och integrera den här lösningen i vår miljö?"

Därför behöver du kunna ta ansvar för den tekniska dialogen från första workshop till färdig lösning.

Erfarenhet

Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av teknisk implementation, systemintegration, applikationsplattformar eller IT-infrastruktur.
Du har sannolikt arbetat med flera av följande områden:
Windows Server
Microsoft SQL Server eller motsvarande databaser
Active Directory och Entra ID
SSO, SAML, OAuth eller andra autentiseringslösningar
DNS och grundläggande nätverk
API:er och systemintegrationer
Servicekonton och behörighetshantering
Certifikathantering (TLS/SSL)
Logganalys och felsökning
PowerShell eller annan scripting
Applikationsinstallationer i on-premises- eller hybridmiljöer

Du behöver inte kunna allt ovan. Det viktigaste är att du har en god teknisk förståelse och förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i nya miljöer, system och integrationsscenarier.

En viktig del av rollen: kunden

Det här är en konsultnära roll där teknik och kunddialog går hand i hand.
Du kommer att arbeta tillsammans med IT-chefer, systemägare, säkerhetsansvariga och tekniska specialister för att förstå verksamhetens krav och omsätta dem till fungerande tekniska lösningar.
Du ska kunna leda diskussioner kring exempelvis:
Infrastrukturkrav för våra lösningar
Integrationer mot befintliga system
Behörighets- och autentiseringsmodeller
Säkerhetskrav och certifikathantering
Databasdesign och prestandafrågor
Migreringar och uppgraderingar

Fokus är att säkerställa att Syneritys lösningar fungerar optimalt i kundens miljö, inte att administrera eller förvalta kundens infrastruktur.

Som person

Vi tror att du:
känner dig trygg i tekniska diskussioner.
gillar att felsöka och förstå grundorsaken till problem.
tar ägarskap och driver tekniska frågor i mål.
är strukturerad och noggrann.
kan kommunicera med både tekniker och verksamhetsrepresentanter.
tycker om att arbeta nära kunder.
har lätt för att sätta dig in i nya produkter och tekniska lösningar.
kan arbeta självständigt men uppskattar ett kompetent team omkring dig.

Vi tror också att du har tillräckligt mycket erfarenhet för att veta att de bästa tekniska lösningarna börjar med att förstå kundens behov, miljö och förutsättningar.

Varför välja Synerity?

På Synerity får du det bästa av två världar – en konsultfirma som jobbar med marknadsledande lösningar, i en personlig och dynamisk arbetsmiljö där dina idéer och initiativ verkligen gör skillnad.
Snabb påverkan & inflytande
– Hos oss är beslutsvägarna korta, vilket innebär att dina idéer snabbt kan omsättas i verklighet. Du får möjlighet att påverka processer och projekt och har stor frihet i vilken riktning du driver din roll.
Utvecklingsmöjligheter
– Till skillnad från större bolag med komplex organisation, försvinner du inte i mängden. Här får du snabbt nya utmaningar och möjlighet att växa i din roll tillsammans med företaget.
Meningsfulla kundrelationer
– Vi arbetar nära våra kunder och bygger långsiktiga relationer som en pålitlig partner. Som konsult hos oss blir du en nyckelperson för dina kunder.
Flexibilitet och balans
– Vi vet att livet inte bara handlar om jobb. Vi träffas gärna och vi har kontor i Helsingborg, Malmö, Stockholm & Göteborg. Vi har dock en generellt flexibel arbetsmiljö där du kan hitta balans mellan arbete och fritid och för rätt person spelar geografisk placering mindre roll.

What matters most is your motivation to work at the crossroads of business, technology, and processes, and your drive to solve complex business problems across a variety of industries.

Solid programming skills. We pick whatever tool fits the problem best, but you'll thrive here if you know one or more of: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Java, Clojure, Scala, Swift, Kotlin, React Native, C#, F#, .NET
Experience with a cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

Fluent spoken and written Finnish and English skills

We work closely with our clients, often on-site, so we're looking for candidates who live in, or are planning to move to, the Greater Helsinki area.

Things move fast, and being part of a growing consultancy means real room to make your mark and shape where we're headed. We want to help our clients understand why cloud services can support their growth and how to embark on a sustainable cloud journey. Our strong Azure expertise, combined with our highest-level Microsoft partnership, enables us to act as a long-term and trusted partner to our customers, helping them develop their cloud services securely, efficiently and with cost optimization in mind.

We are now looking to strengthen our team of Azure professionals with an Azure Architect
and invite you to join us in building a sustainable future! Sustainability is one of our core principles, and we have, for example, signed the Microsoft Partner Pledge.

As an Azure Architect, you will design, implement, maintain and continuously develop new and sustainable cloud services for a wide range of customers. Our clients include major organisations such as Valmet, S Group and Varma (customer case).

What is the role about?

We are looking for an Azure Architect with strong expertise and experience particularly in Kubernetes solutions. In this role, you will take the lead in designing and implementing demanding container solutions using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
, ensuring that they are scalable, secure and reliable.

A key part of the role is also strategically planning future technology directions, designing environments that support evolving business needs, and driving innovation through new cloud technologies. You will play an important role in developing business continuity and resilience solutions tailored to container-based applications, guiding smooth migrations and optimising system performance for both current and future needs.

In this key role, you will work with a diverse range of clients across different industries, providing both strategic direction and technical leadership in using container technologies to transform their businesses.

As a professional at Knowit, you will have every opportunity to put your expertise to use while continuing to develop your skills with the latest modern technologies. We encourage experimentation and trying new things, and you can steer the development of your expertise in the direction that best supports your growth as a cloud professional.

Building service solutions based on Microsoft Azure cloud architectures covers the entire journey, from definition and design to development and deployment. You will work as part of client teams alongside other experienced Azure professionals, right at the intersection of technology and our clients’ businesses.

What do we expect from you?

At Knowit, we are all makers at heart: we keep our promises and approach our work with passion. We are proud of our broad expertise and take pride in what we do. Being a consultant at Knowit can be summarized as follows

The ability to present and communicate ideas, best practices, and technical solutions to various stakeholders—from development teams to non-technical audiences.
The ability to see technologies as tools for solving technical problems and delivering value.
A built-in curiosity to learn new things, experiment with new technologies and practices, develop professionally, and share knowledge with others.

In addition to the maker mindset, we expect you to have a genuine interest in the technical side of Azure. .

3–5 years of experience with Azure cloud services. This means an interest in designing and defining architectures and/or strong expertise in implementing them. Infrastructure as Code (IaC) is our preferred way of working.
3–5 years of experience in container orchestration, preferably in an Azure environment, particularly in designing, developing, deploying, maintaining and troubleshooting container-based applications and their architectures using technologies such as Kubernetes and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
A DevOps mindset: you understand modern approaches to building solutions using native tools and code, and actively look for opportunities to automate everything from infrastructure to business logic.
Strong expertise in designing and implementing CI/CD pipelines for container-based applications, including Azure Container Registry integrations and the use of Helm package management.
Experience in implementing and managing security practices in Kubernetes environments, such as network policies and security contexts, as well as a good understanding of Azure security tools such as Defender for Cloud.

Skills that are considered an advantage, but are not required:

Experience with Kubernetes monitoring tools such as Prometheus and Grafana
Ingress controllers and Gateway API
Azure DevOps and GitHub
Infrastructure as Code experience with Azure Bicep
Experience with GitOps tools such as FluxCD and ArgoCD
AI policies, AI Gateway and MCP servers

At Knowit, we value broad expertise as well as the willingness to explore and master new areas. We take pride in our hands-on way of working and our deep technical expertise.

And because we don't want this to be just a one-sided wish list, we want you to have the opportunity to shape your role as an expert and take ownership of your professional development, with our support. Everyone is welcome to be their whole self at Knowit, and we consider a relaxed yet professional working community valuable in its own right.

A team and community where it is easy to grow and get support when you need it. Our people are at different stages of their careers, and we offer opportunities that challenge and develop both recent graduates and more experienced professionals.
Our People Lead model, which has received a lot of positive feedback internally. We believe that a manager's most important responsibility is to ensure that you, as an expert, have the best possible conditions to succeed in your work and develop professionally.

Flexible remote and hybrid working arrangements that adapt to different life situations.
An excellent work-life balance. We work on large and meaningful projects in sustainable digitalization, but we also recognize that everyone is a whole person and that there is more to everyday life than work.
A comprehensive range of employee benefits, including lunch, commuting and sports/culture benefits, extensive occupational healthcare, accident insurance, work equipment of your choice, recruitment and sales lead bonuses, and the possibility of temporarily working remotely from abroad.

Interested?
