In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About The Team

We are looking for an experienced Manager, Tax Technology to lead tax platform projects for Wolt and Deliveroo within our growing Tax Team. As Wolt and Deliveroo onboard onto the global unified tax platform and a single tax calculation engine (Vertex), this role owns the functional tax leadership that turns business and VAT requirements into configured, tested, live capabilities, and leads the offshore Wolt & Deliveroo implementation team delivering that work day to day. As DoorDash continues to grow its international footprint, we are looking for a candidate with deep, hands-on experience in VAT regimes who can lead a team, collaborate cross-functionally, and own the delivery of tax features and new-platform feature / new-market / new-partnership launches across Wolt and Deliveroo.

About The Role

You will report to the Senior Manager of the Tax Calculation Platform & Mx Operations and lead tax platform and business projects for Wolt and Deliveroo. You will manage a team to deliver day-to-day VAT configuration and testing, and partner closely with Tax Engineering, the Wolt and Deliveroo Tax teams, Tax Product, and other stakeholders — gathering business and VAT requirements, translating them into tax-system functional requirements for configuration and testing, and reviewing Technical Design Documents (TDDs) to provide functional tax expertise back to Tax Engineering.

The primary focus of this position is end-to-end delivery of VAT tax solutions across the Wolt and Deliveroo platforms — new product, market, partnership launches and legislative changes, roadmap alignment with Wolt and Deliveroo's international expansion, and day-to-day leadership of the team executing that delivery — with an understanding of how data flows from upstream systems through the tax engine to downstream reporting. Rather than handing off requirements to the Vertex Center of Excellence team, you will apply your own Vertex knowledge to help influence the functional design and determine the specific Vertex configuration a solution requires. Familiarity with US sales and use tax, food and beverage, and retail tax context is valuable for alignment with the broader platform.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

Lead tax platform and business projects across the Wolt and Deliveroo platforms, including new product, market, partnership launches, and legislative changes.
Gather business and VAT requirements and translate them into tax-system functional requirements for configuration, testing and delivery.
Review BRDs, PRDs, and TDDs for VAT tax-system implications and provide functional tax expertise back to Tax Engineering.
Define testing requirements and oversee validations across unit, integration, E2E, shadow, and post-launch phases.
Align tax engine priorities and the integrated delivery plan with the Wolt and Deliveroo international market roadmaps, and represent tax platform status updates to Tax and Engineering leadership.
Trace VAT-relevant data from upstream systems through Vertex to downstream reporting and compliance.
Serve as the senior functional tax leader for Wolt and Deliveroo, escalating risk and driving cross-functional alignment across Tax, Product, Engineering, and Data.
Manage and develop a team supporting this area, allocating workload, establishing QA checkpoints, and providing structured knowledge transfer on complex processes.

We’re excited about you because…

You have 8+ years of indirect tax or indirect tax technology experience, with several years working directly in VAT regimes.
You are familiar with VAT tax requirements and can translate them into system requirements.
Hands-on experience implementing or configuring Vertex O Series, and ability to review Vertex configurations and testing documentation and provide feedback.
Hand-on experience implementing or configuring ERP tax integration (e.g. Netsuite) with Vertex tax engine.
Experience with multi-country VAT implementations and EU VAT compliance; familiarity with non-US indirect tax regimes more broadly is a plus.
Demonstrated people-leadership experience, including managing, coaching, workload delegation, and quality oversight.
You can review technical design documents and provide functional tax expertise to engineering and product.
You have familiarity with US sales and use tax, food and beverage, and retail tax context.
You understand how tax data flows from upstream transaction systems through a tax engine to downstream reporting, including both in-house systems or ERP system integration flows.
Program or project management experience across dependent teams, including building plans, milestones, and dependency maps, and driving them to completion.
Comfort operating cross-functionally and building trust with partner teams without always holding formal authority over their roadmaps.
Experience in use of SQL or Snowflake for data self-serve, issue investigation or testing validation.
Experience in use of API testing tools like Postman, SOAP UI and ability to read XML and JSON logs.
Accounting, Finance, Information Technology, or Computer Science degree.
You are fluent in leveraging multiple AI tools on the market (e.g., Claude Cowork, ChatGPT, Gemini, Cursor) on a daily basis across all of your assigned tasks, and you actively look for creative ways to apply them to enhance processes and create efficiency gains.

Nice to Haves

Familiarity with Marketplace Facilitator laws.
Experience managing offshore teams across time zones.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
The Company

Finalto is a global provider in the over-the-counter trading space, offering brokerages and institutional clients our cutting-edge trading platform—ClearVision. With liquidity from Tier 1 banks, ClearVision ensures superior pricing and execution quality. Our R&D hub in Copenhagen drives continuous innovation and top-tier application performance.

The Job

As a Senior Software Engineer in the Integrations Team, you will participate in the full SDLC from analysis and design through implementation, testing, release, and production support. You will independently own integration work and help develop and maintain services connecting ClearVision with clients, Tier 1 banks, liquidity providers, and trading venues. You will work directly with third parties to clarify behaviour, coordinate testing and investigation, and drive joint issues to resolution.

ClearVision is built on proprietary frameworks and established engineering patterns. We do not expect you to know them before joining; every engineer goes through a learning period. What matters is your ability to understand unfamiliar systems, structure ambiguous work, design robust components, and make sound decisions. This is a senior individual-contributor role, not a Technical Lead or domain-lead position. Deliverables must meet high standards of correctness, latency, performance, and reliability.

Qualifications

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with the skills and capabilities to match:
·        Degree in computer science or software engineering, or equivalent experience
·        5+ years of professional software development experience, including:
o  production software in C#/.NET or a comparable object-oriented language
o  concurrent, event-driven, or distributed systems
o  automated testing and tools such as Git, Visual Studio, MSBuild, and NUnit
·         Ability to structure ambiguous work, make sound trade-offs, and design maintainable components.
·         Experience owning third-party integrations and managing external technical stakeholders through joint problem solving.
·         FIX or electronic-trading experience is a plus, not a requirement.
·        Strong knowledge of OOP, SOLID, data structures, algorithms, network protocols, testing, observability, and production reliability.

Who You Are

You are analytical, structured, and comfortable taking independent ownership without being the formal lead. You communicate clearly, engage internal and external stakeholders in shared problem solving, and keep work moving across organisational boundaries. You care about clean, maintainable code, production reliability, and pragmatic engineering decisions.

The Workplace

You will be working in our office at Amerikakaj, Copenhagen. Onsite work is mandatory for a minimum of 60% to secure cooperation and coherence within the team.

For inquiries, contact our HR Business Partner, Sophie Lykke, sophie.lykke@finalto.com. 

To learn more about Finalto, visit www.finalto.com .

jobs.title: Azure Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
Om dit kommende job

Fellowmind Managed Platform – FMP – er vores fælles platform til standardiseret, sikker og effektiv håndtering af kundernes Azure-miljøer. Platformen kombinerer automatisering, governance og managed services i en skalerbarløsning, der løbende udvikles i takt med kundernes behov og Microsofts teknologier.

Som Azure Platform Engineer bliver du en del af hele platformens livscyklus. Du kommer både til at onboarde nye kunder, implementere løsninger og bidrage til den løbende udvikling og drift af platformen.

Du arbejder tæt sammen med kunder, konsulenter, arkitekter og resten af FMP-teamet. Du får gradvist mere indflydelse i takt med, at du lærer platformen, kunderne og vores arbejdsmetoder at kende.

Dine Arbejdsopgaver Vil Blandt Andet Være

Onboarding af nye kunder og deres Azure-miljøer på FMP
Implementering og konfiguration af platformskomponenter
Automatisering af deployment, konfiguration og driftsopgaver
Udvikling og vedligeholdelse af Infrastructure as Code
Fejlsøgning og håndtering af tekniske problemstillinger
Test, dokumentation og kvalitetssikring af løsninger
Deltagelse i dialogen med kunder om behov og mulige løsninger
Bidrag til videreudvikling af FMP’s funktionalitet, værktøjer og standarder

Sådan arbejder vi

FMP-teamet arbejder efter principperne i Golazo. Vi deler arbejdet op i mindre, værdiskabende leverancer og afstemmer tilgang og design, før vi går i gang med implementeringen.

Vi betragter ikke en opgave som færdig, blot fordi teknikken virker. Test, dokumentation, monitorering og validering hos kunden er en del af leverancen.

Du behøver ikke kende Golazo på forhånd. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at arbejde struktureret, gøre dit arbejde synligt og give og modtage konstruktiv feedback.

Om teamet

Du bliver en del af vores Cloud, Security & Operations-team og får din daglige gang i det tværfaglige team omkring FMP.

Teamet består af konsulenter og arkitekter med forskellige faglige styrker inden for blandt andet Azure, automatisering, sikkerhed, softwareudvikling og managed services. Vi arbejder på tværs af Fellowminds lokationer og lande oglægger stor vægt på samarbejde, fælles ejerskab og videndeling.

Du får mulighed for at lære af erfarne kolleger og samtidig sætte dit eget præg på platformen og vores måde at arbejde på.

Om dine kompetencer

Der kan være flere veje ind i rollen. Du kan eksempelvis have en baggrund som cloud- eller infrastrukturkonsulent, DevOps engineer, platform engineer eller udvikler med interesse for Azure.

Vi forestiller os at du

Har en teknisk nysgerrighed og et solidt fundament inden for cloudteknologier. Du har praktisk erfaring med Azure eller lignende cloudplatforme og har arbejdet med automatisering, scripting eller Infrastructure as Code. Samtidig har du forståelse for centrale områder som sikkerhed, governance og stabil drift, og du trives med at analysere tekniske problemstillinger og arbejde struktureret frem mod holdbare løsninger.

Du er vant til at dokumentere dit arbejde og dele viden med dine kolleger, og du kan arbejde selvstændigt inden for klare rammer. Derudover motiveres du af at kombinere produktudvikling med konkrete kundeopgaver, hvor du kan omsætte teknologi til værdi. Du kommunikerer professionelt og ubesværet på både dansk og engelsk.

Det Er En Fordel, Hvis Du Har Erfaring Med

Azure landing zones, governance og identitetsstyring med Azure Policy, RBAC og Microsoft Entra ID
Infrastructure as Code med eksempelvis Bicep, Terraform eller tilsvarende teknologier
Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD samt automatisering med PowerShell, Azure CLI eller lignende værktøjer
Monitorering, logging og observability samt kendskab til Cloud Adoption Framework, Well-Architected Framework eller drift af cloudplatforme

Vi forventer ikke, at du allerede kan det hele. Det vigtigste er, at du har et godt teknisk fundament, er nysgerrig og har lyst til at udvikle dig sammen med platformen og teamet.

Om dig

Du går op i kvalitet og tager ansvar for, at dine leverancer fungerer i praksis. Du er nysgerrig, opsøger ny viden og spørger om hjælp, når det skaber et bedre resultat.

Du trives med at arbejde i et team, hvor løsninger bliver kvalificeret gennem dialog og review. Du kan stå på egne ben, men holder ikke viden eller udfordringer for dig selv.

Samtidig har du blik for, at den bedste tekniske løsning ikke nødvendigvis er den mest avancerede. Den skal være forståelig, driftsvenlig og skabe reel værdi for kunden.

Fellowmind Managed Platform er vores fælles platform til standardiseret, sikker og effektiv håndtering af kundernes Azure-miljøer. Platformen kombinerer automatisering, governance og managed services i en skalerbarløsning, der løbende udvikles i takt med kundernes behov og Microsofts teknologier.

Som Senior Azure Architect får du en central rolle i platformens tekniske udvikling. Du bliver medansvarlig for, at FMP har en tydelig arkitektur, kan skaleres på tværs af kunder og samtidig er sikker, driftsvenlig og enkel at videreudvikle.

Du arbejder både strategisk og hands-on. Du skal kunne drive en designproces og træffe tekniske beslutninger, men også være tæt nok på implementeringen til at sikre, at arkitekturen fungerer i praksis.

Dine Arbejdsopgaver Vil Blandt Andet Være

Sætte teknisk retning for FMP og omsætte den til konkrete, prioriterede forbedringer
Designe standardiserede og skalerbare løsninger på tværs af kundemiljøer
Drive teknisk afklaring og udarbejde korte, præcise designdokumenter
Sikre sammenhæng mellem arkitektur, sikkerhed, governance, drift og kundeoplevelse
Kvalificere komplekse kundekrav og omsætte dem til genanvendelige funktioner og services
Foretage tekniske reviews og sikre kvalitet i design og implementering
Identificere teknisk gæld, risici og muligheder for automatisering
Understøtte onboarding af komplekse kunder og håndtere tekniske eskalationer
Sparre med kunder, arkitekter og interne interessenter om roadmap og løsningsvalg
Mentorere kolleger og bidrage til at løfte teamets tekniske niveau
Skabe fælles standarder, dokumentation og beslutningsgrundlag
Bidrage aktivt til implementering, fejlsøgning og proof of concepts, når opgaven kræver det

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Software Engineer to design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality software solutions that support business objectives and deliver a reliable user experience. The ideal candidate is a strong problem solver who writes clean, maintainable code, collaborates effectively with cross-functional teams, and contributes to the continuous improvement of software systems, tools, and engineering practices.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, test, and deploy scalable software applications and system features.
Translate business and user requirements into technical specifications and practical software solutions.
Write clean, efficient, reusable, and well-documented code following agreed coding standards.
Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to improve quality and maintainability.
Debug, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects across development, testing, and production environments.
Collaborate with cross functional teams, and other stakeholders to deliver reliable solutions.
Improve application performance, reliability, security, and scalability through regular analysis and optimization.
Support software releases, deployment activities, and post-release monitoring.
Maintain technical documentation for systems, APIs, processes, and operational procedures.
Stay current with relevant technologies, tools, frameworks, and software engineering best practices.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
Proven experience in software development, application engineering, or a similar technical role.
Strong programming capability in one or more languages such as Python, C#, or similar.
Understanding of software development life cycle practices, including requirements analysis, design, coding, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
Experience with databases, APIs, version control systems, and modern development tools.
Ability to analyse technical problems, evaluate options, and implement effective solutions.
Hands-on experience applying AI tools such as GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, or similar platforms to accelerate software development, generate technical documentation, support code reviews, or improve productivity.
Good communication skills and ability to work effectively in a team environment.
Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud is added advantage

Other information

Working Hours : 8.15am to 5.30pm (Mon-Fri)
Location : Changi North
Company Bus : Pick up at Ang Mo Kio, Yishun, Hougang, Punggol, Pasir Ris, Bedok, Tampines MRT/Interchanges

Education Background

jobs.title: Manufacturing Systems Engineer 2
jobs.description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?

At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients.

Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

Position Summary

The Manufacturing Systems Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, integrating, and supporting digital manufacturing solutions across MES, equipment data systems, operational applications, analytics platforms, and AI-enabled manufacturing capabilities.

This role partners with Manufacturing, Process Engineering, Equipment Engineering, Quality, and OT teams to build and sustain data-driven manufacturing workflows that improve operational efficiency, equipment reliability, troubleshooting effectiveness, and digital transformation initiatives

Position Responsibilities

Design, develop, and support digital/AI manufacturing solutions that improve operational efficiency, data visibility, and decision-making across manufacturing operations.
Design and support system integrations between manufacturing and equipment enterprise systems, equipment data sources and enterprise data platforms.
Develop and optimize databases, data pipelines, APIs, and reporting solutions to ensure reliable and scalable manufacturing data flows.
Design and build AI agents capable of making business-context-aware decisions, taking actions across enterprise systems and workflows, and operating autonomously within defined guardrails
Design, develop, test, and deploy AI-powered products, applications, and intelligent workflow solutions
Collaborate with Manufacturing, Process Engineering, Equipment Engineering, Quality, OT, and IT teams to translate business requirements into digital solutions.
Support system testing, validation, deployment, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management of manufacturing applications and integrations.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives through automation, analytics, and digital transformation projects.
Contribute to future manufacturing capabilities including operational intelligence, AI-assisted troubleshooting, predictive analytics, and smart manufacturing solutions.

Listed responsibilities are an essential, but not exhaustive list, of the usual duties associated with the position. Changes to individual responsibilities may occur due to business needs.

Position Requirements

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, or related discipline.
3-5 years of experience in software development, application development, systems engineering, system integration, data engineering, or related technical roles.
Strong database design and development experience using Microsoft SQL Server, including query optimization, views, and stored procedures.
Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Python, C#, Java, JavaScript, or equivalent object-oriented languages.
Experience developing and supporting software applications, APIs, and system integrations.
Experience using source control and version management tools such as GitHub.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Ability to manage multiple tasks, collaborate across functions, and deliver high-quality solutions in a dynamic manufacturing environment.
Understanding of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), testing methodologies, and deployment practices.
Experience with building and deploying AI agents in enterprise environments
Demonstrated success developing agents that interact with and coordinate activities across multiple business platforms and technology ecosystems.
Experience implementing multi-agent architectures, agent orchestration frameworks, tool calling and workflow execution, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, knowledge retrieval, and reasoning systems.

All listed requirements are deemed as essential functions to this position; however, business conditions may require reasonable accommodations for additional task and responsibilities

Preferred Experience/Education/Skills

Experience with manufacturing systems, or industrial data platforms.
Experience with Power BI, Databricks, Azure, cloud technologies, data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, and analytics platforms.
Experience implementing AI solutions within large, global enterprises
Exposure to operational technology, equipment connectivity, or industrial automation environments.
Knowledge of vector databases, semantic search, enterprise knowledge management, and RAG solution patterns.
Experience developing operational dashboards, reporting solutions, manufacturing applications, or workflow automation tools.
Knowledge of AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, diagnostic solutions, knowledge management systems
Experience working in regulated manufacturing, medical device, biotechnology, life sciences, semiconductor, or high-tech manufacturing environments.
Demonstrated interest in digital transformation, manufacturing systems integration, data-driven operations, and smart manufacturing initiatives.

jobs.title: Senior QA / Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
Sourceability® is a global digital distributor of electronic components transforming how modern businesses bring products to market. With innovation, quality and logistics as the backbone of the company, Sourceability's cutting-edge products and services expedite the procurement process across a wide range of industries, including communications/cellular, consumer electronics, and auto manufacturing.

Sourceability is building a new Global Engineering Organization (GEO) to strengthen internal software delivery, improve production ownership, and build long-term engineering capability inside the company.

We are looking for a Senior QA / Test Automation Engineer to help build quality discipline and test automation capability inside GEO. This role will support business-critical software platforms by improving test coverage, regression testing, defect validation, release readiness, and automation practices across engineering teams.

This role is not limited to writing automated tests. The right candidate should be able to combine hands-on manual testing, exploratory testing, test automation, defect analysis, UAT support, and risk communication. At the current stage of GEO, some systems may have limited automated coverage, incomplete documentation, and legacy behavior that must be understood carefully before changes are released.

The Senior QA / Test Automation Engineer will work closely with Software Engineers, Product / Delivery Managers, Product Group Team Leads / Architects, DevOps, DBA, Infrastructure, and business stakeholders to reduce production risk and improve confidence in releases.

This role is hybrid working from our Singapore office.

Insight on Your Impact:

In this role, you will:

Design, develop, and maintain automated test coverage for web applications, APIs, integrations, mobile workflows, and internal business platforms.
Execute manual, exploratory, functional, regression, integration, API, and release validation testing where automation does not yet exist or is not practical.
Build and improve test automation frameworks, test scripts, reusable test utilities, and test data approaches.
Define practical regression testing strategies for business-critical systems, including SourceCore, mobile applications, integrations, legacy applications, and other GEO-supported platforms.
Partner with Product / Delivery Managers to understand acceptance criteria, business workflows, UAT expectations, and release scope.
Partner with Product Group Team Leads / Architects and Software Engineers to understand technical design, risk areas, edge cases, and testability concerns.
Participate in backlog refinement by identifying missing acceptance criteria, unclear requirements, test dependencies, and quality risks.
Create and maintain test plans, test cases, test data, and validation checklists aligned with product requirements and business workflows.
Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects clearly through agreed tools and processes, including Azure DevOps where applicable.
Verify fixes, confirm regression impact, and help determine whether a release is ready for production.
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines in partnership with DevOps and engineering teams.
Analyze test failures, flaky tests, environmental issues, and data-related problems to help engineering teams distinguish product defects from test or environment problems.
Support UAT by helping Product / Delivery Managers and business users prepare validation scenarios, review acceptance criteria, and reproduce reported issues.
Communicate quality risks, test coverage gaps, defect trends, and release readiness concerns to engineering and product stakeholders.
Contribute to post-release issue analysis and help convert production defects into regression coverage and process improvements.
Mentor junior QA engineers and help establish practical QA standards, automation practices, and quality expectations across GEO.

Your Qualifications, Your Influence:

To be successful in this role, you should have:

5+ years of experience in software quality assurance, with strong hands-on experience in both manual testing and test automation.
Proven experience building, maintaining, or extending test automation frameworks using tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Appium, or equivalent.
Strong understanding of functional, regression, integration, API, exploratory, smoke, performance, and release validation testing.
Experience testing business-critical software systems where defects can directly affect operations, users, customers, or financial processes.
Ability to read and write code in at least one programming language such as JavaScript / TypeScript, C#, Python, or Java.
Experience with API testing tools and approaches such as Postman, REST Assured, Playwright API testing, or similar frameworks.
Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or similar.
Practical understanding of SQL and ability to validate data, investigate defects, prepare test data, and confirm backend behavior.
Experience writing clear defects, test cases, test plans, acceptance criteria feedback, and quality risk summaries.
Ability to work with incomplete requirements, legacy behavior, and complex business workflows without losing testing discipline.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a methodical approach to reproducing, isolating, and documenting issues.
Clear communication skills with the ability to explain quality risks, testing limits, defect impact, and release readiness to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Comfortable working in distributed teams across multiple locations and time zones.
Strong ownership mindset, attention to detail, and practical judgment under delivery pressure.

Preferred Skills and Technical Familiarity:

The following experience will be helpful in this role:

Experience testing .NET / SQL Server-backed enterprise applications.
Experience testing internal platforms used by sales, purchasing, warehouse, finance, operations, customer service, or other business teams.
Experience with mobile test automation for Android or iOS using Appium, Espresso, XCUITest, or similar tools.
Experience testing warehouse applications, barcode scanning workflows, image capture workflows, or field / operations-facing mobile applications.
Experience with performance and load testing tools such as k6, JMeter, Gatling, or similar.
Experience with test data management, environment validation, release smoke testing, and regression suite design.
Familiarity with accessibility testing, security testing concepts, or basic application vulnerability validation.
Experience in electronic components, technology distribution, supply chain, logistics, manufacturing, e-commerce, or similar B2B environments.
Exposure to AI-assisted testing tools or practical use of automation to improve test coverage and QA productivity.

Success in the First 90 Days:

Within the first 90 days, the Senior QA / Test Automation Engineer should be able to:

Understand assigned systems, business workflows, release process, current test coverage, and major production quality risks.
Establish working relationships with Software Engineers, Product / Delivery Managers, Team Leads / Architects, DevOps, DBA, Infrastructure, and business stakeholders.
Review existing QA practices, test cases, automation coverage, defect patterns, and release readiness gaps.
Define a practical regression testing approach for at least one business-critical platform or product group.
Create or improve automated test coverage for high-value workflows where automation will reduce release risk.
Improve defect reporting quality, reproduction steps, acceptance criteria validation, and test evidence discipline.
Help create clear release validation / smoke testing checklists for critical systems.
Support at least one release or UAT cycle with structured test planning, defect tracking, and risk communication.
Identify major test data, environment, documentation, or automation gaps and propose a practical improvement plan.
Start converting repeated production defects or recurring manual checks into regression coverage.

What This Role Does Not Own:

This role does not own formal people management for engineers or QA staff. Engineering Managers remain responsible for hiring, performance management, compensation input, team structure, and capacity planning.

This role does not independently approve production releases. Release decisions require alignment with Engineering Managers, Product / Delivery Managers, Team Leads / Architects, QA, DevOps, and relevant business stakeholders.

This role does not own business prioritization or final user acceptance. Product / Delivery Managers and business stakeholders remain responsible for business priority alignment, UAT coordination, and final business acceptance.

This role does not replace software engineering ownership of code quality. QA improves test coverage, validation, and release confidence, but engineers and technical leads remain responsible for building maintainable and reliable software.

Benefits:

Competitive salary
Ongoing training and professional development opportunities
Collaborative global work environment
PTO

KYVOGEN is a software company. We build web platforms, mobile apps and AI products that run real businesses. You will be our first technical leader. You will own the architecture of everything we build, make the technical decisions, and hire and lead the engineering team that owns our code with you.

• Own the architecture of all our products: web apps, APIs, databases, mobile apps and infrastructure.

• Set the standard for security in systems that process payroll and tax documents.
• Build the engineering foundations: automated tests, CI/CD, environments, code review, monitoring and backups.
• Hire, mentor and lead a small engineering team, and define how we work so the team owns the whole codebase.

Beschrijving van de opdracht

Context

Het FAVV gebruikt ServiceNow als Enterprise Service Management (ESM)-platform. De modules ITSM, HRSD en CSM zijn operationeel en worden intensief gebruikt door verschillende departementen binnen de organisatie.
Voor de verdere uitbouw van de Customer Service Management (CSM) module zoeken we een ServiceNow CSM Developer die de reeds gedefinieerde business requirements implementeert op het platform, met een consequente focus op het gebruik van de standaardfunctionaliteiten van CSM om zo dicht mogelijk bij out-of-the-box (OOTB) te blijven.

Rolbeschrijving

Als ServiceNow CSM Developer sta je in voor de ontwikkeling en implementatie van oplossingen binnen de Customer Service Management (CSM) module. Samen met de CSM Architect en de business analist maak je deel uit van een team van drie personen dat instaat voor de oplevering van CSM 2.0.
Je vertaalt de gevraagde business requirements naar werkende configuraties en ontwikkelingen op het platform en zorgt voor een kwaliteitsvolle en onderhoudbare oplevering. Je hanteert daarbij een uitgesproken technische invalshoek, met een sterke focus op het gebruik van de standaardmogelijkheden en best practices van CSM om zo dicht mogelijk bij out-of-the-box (OOTB) te blijven. Zo draag je bij aan een schaalbaar, performant en upgradebaar platform.

Algemene verantwoordelijkheden

Ontwikkelen en implementeren van CSM-oplossingen op basis van de gevraagde business requirements.
Maximaal inzetten op de standaardmogelijkheden en best practices van CSM (OOTB-first) en customisatie beperken.
Instaan voor de kwaliteit, performantie, onderhoudbaarheid en upgradebaarheid van de opgeleverde oplossingen.
Bijdragen aan een vlot delivery- en releaseproces, tot en met go-live en nazorg.
Bijdragen aan kennisdeling binnen het interne ServiceNow-team.

Specifieke verantwoordelijkheden

1. Implementatie van business requirements (CSM)

Vertalen van de aangeleverde requirements naar concrete configuratie binnen de CSM-module.
Realiseren van cases, casetypes, workflows, catalogusitems en record producers volgens de gevraagde behoeften.
Afstemmen met de betrokken teams om de requirements correct en volledig te kunnen realiseren.
Opleveren van werkende oplossingen doorheen de delivery-cyclus, tot go-live en nazorg.

2. OOTB-first & gebruik van de CSM-standaarden

Maximaal benutten van de standaardfunctionaliteiten en standaardelementen van CSM.
Oplossingen ontwerpen die aansluiten bij de out-of-the-box mogelijkheden en de ServiceNow best practices.
Customisatie kritisch afwegen en tot een minimum beperken; de impact op upgradebaarheid bewaken.
Behoeften waar mogelijk invullen met standaardconfiguratie in plaats van maatwerk.

3. Configuratie & ontwikkeling

Configureren van Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, ACL's, notificaties en SLA's/OLA's binnen de grenzen van de standaard.
Gericht ontwikkelen met JavaScript/GlideScript en Flow Designer / UI Builder, enkel waar de standaard niet volstaat.
Configureren van de CSM-portalen (Customer/Consumer Service Portal).

4. Integraties, testing & release

Bouwen en ondersteunen van integraties met externe systemen via REST, SOAP en IntegrationHub.
Uitvoeren van unit testing en ondersteunen van user acceptance testing (UAT).
Opvolgen van update sets en bijdragen aan een vlot en gecontroleerd releaseproces.
Oplossen van productieproblemen en bewaken van de platformstabiliteit.

5. Documentatie & kennisdeling

Opstellen en onderhouden van technische documentatie en solution designs.
Documenteren van de gemaakte keuzes rond OOTB versus customisatie.
Bijdragen aan de kennisopbouw en de autonomie van het interne ServiceNow-team.

Benodigde kennis en ervaring

Opleiding & ervaring

Bachelor in ICT of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
Minstens 5 jaar ervaring met ServiceNow-implementatie en -configuratie.
Aantoonbare hands-on ervaring met de CSM-module.

Functionele & technische competenties

Grondige kennis van de standaardfunctionaliteiten en het datamodel van de CSM-module.
Sterke configuratievaardigheden en een OOTB-first, best-practice-gedreven aanpak.
Scripting-vaardigheden (JavaScript/GlideScript, Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, ACL's) voor gerichte uitbreidingen.
Ervaring met Flow Designer en/of UI Builder.
Ervaring met integraties (REST/SOAP, IntegrationHub) is een sterke troef.
Vertrouwd met Agile/Scrum-werkwijzen.

Soft skills

Pragmatisch, oplossingsgericht en kwaliteitsbewust.
Goede communicatievaardigheden richting business en IT.
In staat om zelfstandig te werken en customisatie kritisch af te wegen.

Talen

Goede beheersing van Nederlands of Frans (één als voertaal, de andere minstens zeer goed). Goede kennis van het Engels.

Certificering ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) en CIS-CSM.
Ervaring binnen de federale overheid is een sterke plus.

Ervaring met Virtual Agent, Employee Center of Service Portal.

Entdecke unser Universum und lasse Dich von der positiven Energie der COSMOnaut*innen anstecken.

Gestalte die Zukunft von und mit Menschen und wachse mit uns gemeinsam.

Erlebe echte Wertschätzung in einem sicheren Umfeld voll Leidenschaft und Innovation - ganz unabhängig davon, wann und von wo aus Du arbeiten möchtest.

Werde Teil des Teams und gehöre zu einem der weltweit führenden Microsoft-Partnern für Unternehmenstransformation und Digitalisierung.

Lebe Deinen Job anders
- bewirb Dich bei uns als

Consultant (Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM und Power Platform)

Das macht Dich anders.

Wir sind auf einer Wellenlänge, wenn Du:

smarte Entscheidungen triffst. Du musst nicht immer die richtigen Entscheidungen treffen, aber immer mit bestem Gewissen gegenüber unseren Kunden, Kolleg*innen und COSMO entscheiden.
den Menschen bei all Deinen Überlegungen in den Mittelpunkt stellst. Du achtest auf die Bedürfnisse aller Menschen und agierst mit Empathie und Mitgefühl.
Verantwortung übernimmst. Du bist achtsam gegenüber Dir und Deinen Mitmenschen. Auf Dich kann man sich auch über Deinen Aufgabenbereich hinaus verlassen.
uns dabei unterstützt, großartige Teams zu bilden. Alle für Dich und Du für alle - gemeinsam stärker sein. Du machst den Unterschied in Deinem Team.
immer Dein Bestes gibst. Du musst nicht der oder die Beste sein, aber aus tiefstem Respekt gegenüber Dir und Deinem Umfeld immer das Bestmögliche geben.
den Mut hast zu wachsen. Du denkst nicht in Herausforderungen, sondern in Möglichkeiten. Du liebst es, Dich weiter zu entwickeln, suchst nach neuen Ideen und bringst diese aktiv ein.
Dinge mit Leidenschaft tust. Du weißt, was Dich antreibt und begeistert, lebst Deine Leidenschaft, inspirierst dadurch Dein Umfeld, hast mehr Spaß an Deiner Arbeit und bist erfolgreicher.

Deine Persönlichkeit und Motivation ist das, was Dich ausmacht.

Daher nehmen wir uns die Zeit und schauen alle Bewerbungen individuell durch.

Du möchtest Geschäftsprozesse neu denken und Unternehmen dabei unterstützen, das Potenzial von Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM und der Power Platform erfolgreich zu nutzen?

Dein Alltag - nur ohne Alltag

Du berätst unsere Kunden bei der Optimierung ihrer Geschäftsprozesse und entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihnen Lösungen auf Basis von Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM und der Power Platform.
Dabei begleitest Du Projekte von der ersten Analyse über das Lösungsdesign bis zur Umsetzung und Einführung. Du verstehst die fachlichen Anforderungen unserer Kunden, übersetzt sie in tragfähige Lösungen und behältst dabei immer die End-to-End-Prozesse im Blick.

Je nach Projekt und Erfahrung übernimmst Du dabei unterschiedliche Aufgaben:

Du analysierst Geschäftsprozesse und identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale.
Du führst Workshops mit Fachbereichen und weiteren Projektbeteiligten durch.
Du entwickelst strukturierte Lösungskonzepte und stimmst diese mit unseren Kunden ab.
Du setzt Lösungen selbst um oder koordinierst die Umsetzung im Team.
Du verantwortest Arbeitspakete und stellst Qualität, Standards und eine gute Dokumentation sicher.
Du bewertest Integrationen und Abhängigkeiten zu angrenzenden Systemen.
Du führst Schulungen durch und begleitest die Einführung, damit Lösungen im Arbeitsalltag nachhaltig genutzt werden.
Dabei arbeitest Du nicht nur innerhalb eines einzelnen Systems: Du denkst Prozesse, Daten und Anwendungen ganzheitlich und entwickelst Lösungen, die fachlich sinnvoll, technisch umsetzbar und langfristig skalierbar sind.

Hier bringst du Dich ein:

Du denkst Lösungen konsequent aus Nutzersicht und strukturierst sie in klare, skalierbare Use Cases.
Du übersetzt komplexe Anforderungen in tragfähige Lösungen innerhalb der Microsoft-Plattform und verbindest fachliche und technische Perspektiven.
Du arbeitest eng mit Kunden und internen Teams zusammen und bringst unterschiedliche Perspektiven zielführend zusammen.
Du entwickelst Dein Know-how kontinuierlich weiter, bleibst technologisch am Puls der Zeit und teilst Dein Wissen aktiv.
Du bringst neue Ideen ein, hinterfragst bestehende Lösungen und gestaltest Veränderungen aktiv mit.

Dein Umfeld: Teams, Tools, Zusammenarbeit

Team & Setup

Zusammenarbeit in interdisziplinären Projektteams mit Consultants, Entwickler*innen, Architekt*innen und weiteren Microsoft-Spezialist*innen.
Direkter Austausch mit Kunden, Fachbereichen und Projektbeteiligten von der Anforderungsanalyse bis zur erfolgreichen Einführung von Lösungen.
Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten kombiniert mit engem Teamzusammenhalt, Wissensaustausch und fachlicher Zusammenarbeit.

Tools & Arbeitsweise

Arbeiten im Microsoft-Ökosystem rund um Dynamics 365 CRM (Sales, Customer Service und/oder Field Service), die Power Platform mit Power Apps, Power Automate und Dataverse sowie angrenzende Microsoft- und Azure-Lösungen.
Bewertung und Einsatz neuer Technologien, insbesondere zur Automatisierung und Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen sowie zur Nutzung von KI-Potenzialen.
Strukturierte und priorisierte Arbeitsweise, auch in parallelen Projekten und dynamischen Kundenumgebungen.
Kombination aus eigenständiger Umsetzung, fachlicher Beratung und gezielter Steuerung im Projektteam.

Deine Lernkurve bei COSMO CONSULT

Woche 1–4: Ankommen und verstehen

Du lernst unsere Projektmethoden, Kundenstrukturen und Lösungsansätze kennen.
Du bringst Deine bisherigen Erfahrungen aktiv in laufende Kundenprojekte ein und

übernimmst frühzeitig Verantwortung für erste Themen und Arbeitspakete.

Du verstehst, wie wir Anforderungen in konkrete Lösungen übersetzen und welchen Beitrag diese zum Geschäftserfolg unserer Kunden leisten.

Nach 3 Monaten: Übernehmen und umsetzen

Du verantwortest eigene Arbeitspakete und setzt diese strukturiert und lösungsorientiert um.
Du arbeitest sicher mit Kunden und Projektteams zusammen und bringst Deine fachliche Expertise gezielt in Lösungsdesigns und Projektentscheidungen ein.
Du entwickelst Lösungen weiter und passt Dich flexibel an neue Anforderungen und Technologien an.

Nach 6 Monaten: Weiterentwickeln und mitgestalten

Du berätst Kunden souverän bei der Weiterentwicklung ihrer Geschäftsprozesse und bringst Deine fachliche Expertise gezielt in Lösungsentscheidungen ein.
Du entwickelst bestehende Lösungsansätze innerhalb von Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM und der Power Platform weiter und berücksichtigst dabei fachliche, technische und organisatorische Zusammenhänge.
Du bringst eigene Ideen zur Optimierung von Lösungen, Methoden und Prozessen ein und unterstützt den Wissenstransfer innerhalb des Teams.

Das bringst Du mit:

Erfahrung in der Beratung, Konzeption oder Umsetzung von Lösungen mit Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM
Praxiserfahrung mit der Microsoft Power Platform, insbesondere Power Apps, Power Automate und/oder Dataverse
Kenntnisse in mindestens einem relevanten Dynamics-365-Modul, zum Beispiel Sales, Customer Service oder Field Service
Verständnis für Geschäftsprozesse, Systemgrenzen, Integrationen und End-to-End-Zusammenhänge
Fähigkeit, komplexe Anforderungen zu analysieren und in klare, umsetzbare Lösungen zu übersetzen
Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Workshops und in der Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und Projektteams
Bereitschaft, Verantwortung für fachliche Lösungen und deren erfolgreiche Umsetzung zu übernehmen
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

Aus gesetzlichen Gründen weisen wir darauf hin, dass das kollektivvertragliche, monatliche Mindestgehalt für diese Position € 3.954,- brutto (Vollzeit) beträgt. Unsere tatsächlichen Gehaltspakete orientieren sich an aktuellen Marktgehältern und berücksichtigen selbstverständlich Deine Qualifikation und Erfahrung.

Du entscheidest wann und wo, damit es für Dich, Dein Team und Deinen Arbeitstag am besten passt.
Auf Deiner Reise bist Du nicht allein. Durch unser Level Up Programm gestalten wir Deine berufliche Zukunft gemeinsam.
Wir fragen nicht ob, sondern wie. Unsere Innovation Challenge und die Trainings in unserem COSMO College sind nur einige Beispiele dafür.
Es ist uns wichtig, dass es Dir gut geht. Das bringen wir durch verschiedene Wege und Benefits zum Ausdruck.
Wir kümmern uns um Mensch und Umwelt. Mit #thepowerofpeople schaffen wir einen sicheren Raum für eine positive, nachhaltige und internationale Zusammenarbeit.

Du möchtest Teil des Teams werden?

Dann bewirb Dich mit Deinen aussagefähigen Bewerbungsunterlagen und Deinem frühestmöglichen Eintrittsdatum direkt online.

Du möchtest mehr #insideCOSMO?

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Power Platform & Copilot Studio Engineer (w/m/x)
jobs.description:
Über die Rolle

Als Senior Power Platform Engineer bei Avanade gestalten Sie die digitale Transformation unserer Kunden – von DAX-Konzernen bis hin zu globalen Marktführern. Sie übernehmen Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Lösungen auf Basis der Microsoft Power Platform und arbeiten in einem internationalen Umfeld mit den klügsten Köpfen rund um den Microsoft Stack.

Bei Avanade erwartet Sie ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Kreativität, Innovation und persönliche Weiterentwicklung gleichermaßen gefördert werden. Together we do what matters.

In dieser Rolle gestalten Sie End-to-End-Lösungen über die gesamte Breite der Power Platform: von intelligenten Agenten in Copilot Studio über automatisierte Geschäftsprozesse mit Power Automate bis hin zu maßgeschneiderten Apps mit Canvas und Model-driven Apps. Sie sind technische Sparringspartnerin oder technischer Sparringspartner für unsere Kunden und treiben den Einsatz von Automation und KI im Microsoft-Ökosystem voran.

Das Jahresbruttogehalt für diese Position beginnt gemäß IT-Kollektivvertrag, abhängig von Qualifikation und Erfahrung, bei 70.000€ auf Vollzeitbasis.

Deine Aufgaben

Konzeption und Umsetzung von End-to-End-Lösungen auf der gesamten Power Platform inklusive Agentic AI mit Copilot Studio
Entwicklung von Multi-Agent-Lösungen, Copilot Studio Agents (vormals Power Virtual Agents), Canvas Apps, Cloud Flows, Desktop Flows, Dataverse-Artefakten, AI Builder, Business Process Flows und Model-driven Apps
Architekturentscheidungen und technische Führung in komplexen Enterprise-Projekten
Aufbau und Erweiterung der Power Platform Capabilities bei unseren Kunden
Identifikation von Automatisierungspotenzialen und Effizienzsteigerungen in bestehenden Geschäftsprozessen
Integration der Power Platform mit Microsoft 365, Azure und Drittsystemen
Etablierung von Best Practices, Governance-Modellen, Center of Excellence und ALM-Prozessen
Mentoring und Wissenstransfer im Team sowie bei den Kunden
Kontinuierliches Monitoring neuer Features im Microsoft-Stack und Bewertung für den Kundeneinsatz

Qualifications

Qualifikation und Erfahrung

Power Platform Expertise

Mehrjährige tiefgehende Erfahrung mit der gesamten Power Platform Suite
Expertise in Copilot Studio / Power Virtual Agents inklusive Multi-Agent-Architekturen
Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Power Automate Cloud Flows und Desktop Flows (RPA), inklusive Computer Use
Expertise in der Entwicklung von Canvas Apps und Model-driven Apps
Fundierte Erfahrung mit Dataverse: Datenmodellierung, Security, Plug-ins, Business Rules
Erfahrung mit AI Builder und Business Process Flows
ALM für Power Platform: Solutions, Pipelines, Power Platform CLI, Azure DevOps oder GitHub

KI & moderne Architekturen (nice to have)

Kenntnisse in Azure AI Foundry und Microsoft 365 SDK
Erfahrung mit der Anbindung und Auswahl von Large Language Models (LLM)
Kenntnisse von Model Context Protocol (MCP) und Agent-to-Agent-Kommunikation von Vorteil
Verständnis für Prompt Engineering und Grounding-Strategien

Microsoft Stack

Solides Verständnis von Microsoft 365 inklusive M365 Copilot, Teams und SharePoint
Erfahrung mit Azure Services (Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Storage)
Datenformate XML und JSON sicher im Einsatz
Kenntnisse in Azure AI Foundry und Microsoft 365 SDK, Kenntnisse von Model Context Protocol (MCP) und Agent-to-Agent-Kommunikation von Vorteil

Softwareentwicklung

Erfahrung in mindestens einer der folgenden Technologien: Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, .NET (C#, ASP.NET), PowerShell
Erfahrung mit REST APIs und Custom Connectors
Git, CI/CD-Pipelines

Was dich auszeichnet

Erfahrung in der Beratung und Umsetzung anspruchsvoller Enterprise-Projekte
Souveräne Kommunikation mit Stakeholdern auf Fach- und Management-Ebene
Erfahrung im Anforderungsmanagement - Aufnahme, Analyse und Dokumentation
Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Starte beruflich durch

Einige Der Vorteile Wenn Du Bei Avanade Arbeitest

Die Möglichkeit, für Microsoft Global Alliance Partner des Jahres zu arbeiten (14 Jahre in Folge), mit außergewöhnlichen Möglichkeiten zur Weiterentwicklung und Schulung (mindestens 80 Stunden pro Jahr für Schulungen und bezahlte Zertifizierungen)  
Zusammenarbeit mit technisch versierten und qualifizierten Kolleg:innen weltweit.   
Ein engagierter Career Adviser, der dich bei deinem Karrierewachstum unterstützt.  
Motivierte und hilfsbereite Kolleg:innen, die wirklich an dir interessiert sind. 

Erfahre mehr über einige unserer Vorteile hier
.

Der perfekte Ort zum Arbeiten

Über 60.000 Professionals, 26 Länder und ein Universum – das ist Avanade. Egal welche digitale Fragestellung, im Microsoft-Ökosystem finden wir die Lösung. Denn: Wir sind nicht von schlechten Eltern. Accenture LLP und die Microsoft Corporation haben uns 2000 in die Welt gesetzt. Logisch, dass wir das Beste aus beiden Welten gekonnt verbinden.

Wenn du dich dafür entscheidest, deine Fähigkeiten und individuellen Talente bei Avanade einzubringen, wirst du im Gegenzug einzigartige Erfahrungen, unbegrenzte Lernmöglichkeiten und ambitioniertes Wachstum erleben.

Und während wir auch weiterhin in unsere vielfältige und inklusive Kultur investieren, dabei noch innovativer und kreativer werden, sorgen wir dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen von unseren technischen Innovationen profitieren und es unseren Communities gut geht. Du wirst Teil eines smarten Teams, das dich unterstützt, fördert, leitet und auf deine Expertise baut. Der perfekte Start in einem Unternehmen, das gegründet wurde, um geschäftskritische, führende Technologielösungen zu implementieren und gleichzeitig die Art und Weise, wie Menschen arbeiten, interagieren und leben verbessern möchte.

Do What Matters

Wir glauben daran, dass inklusive und diverse Teams jede Challenge meistern – wer sich Herausforderungen mit Leidenschaft und Mut stellt, ist bei uns genau richtig. Deine Bewerbung ist willkommen - unabhängig deiner Herkunft, Nationalität, Glaube, Behinderung, Alter, Familienstand, Partnerschaftsstatus, sexueller Orientierung und deines Geschlechts. Bei uns darfst du einfach du sein. Vielfalt in jeder Form ist uns eine echte Herzensangelegenheit und ein fester Bestandteil der Avanade-Kultur.

Das klingt nach einen Ort an dem du arbeiten möchtest? Dann schau dir unsere weiterführenden Informationen an:

Sustainable, AI & Cloud Business Services | Avanade

Avanade Insights Blog | Avanade

Insights: Future, reimagined | Avanade

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
LanguageWire is a global leader in language and content services, dedicated to helping brands achieve their full global potential. Since our founding in 2000, we have continuously evolved and developed unique technology to facilitate seamless multilingual communication. Our worldwide network of language experts, coupled with an intuitive online platform, makes it effortless for brands to translate and manage multilingual content. 
The role you'll play 

We're launching a new team dedicated to modernizing and expanding one of our customer-facing tools — and we're looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to help build it from the ground up. This isn't a legacy product handoff: you'll be joining at the very start, shaping both the technical direction and the team culture from day one. 
The current stack is Vue.js on the frontend and Python on the backend, but we're planning a migration to .NET in the near future. Because of this, we're looking for someone comfortable working across all three — Vue, Python, and .NET — who can help drive that transition while continuing to ship new features. As the senior engineer, you'll take a leading role in architecture decisions, technical direction, and mentoring as the team grows. 
The team you'll be a part of 

You'll be one of the founding members of a brand-new team, led by our Tech Team Lead. We're actively growing the team and expect to bring on a Product Manager and one additional Engineer alongside you. This means you'll have real influence over how the team is structured, how we work, and the technical foundations we build on — it's a rare chance to help define a team's culture and practices from the very beginning, rather than stepping into something already set. 

If you want to make a difference, make it with us by... 

Developing and maintaining applications, including front-end interfaces, back-end services, and databases 

Contributing to the architecture, design and implementation of new features and improvements 

Implementing best practices for code quality, testing and deployment automation 

Ensuring high-quality software through active participation in code reviews 

Actively engaging in sprint retrospectives, refinements, daily stand-ups, and other team processes 

Taking full ownership of the products and solutions you develop, eliminating bugs early in the process through TDD/BDD and other tests 

Leveraging AI-assisted development tools and workflows to increase engineering velocity, while maintaining code quality and rigor 

Sharing knowledge and supporting fellow developers, QA professionals, and support teams 

Supporting team leaders with your expertise and assist in customer meetings 

Owning CI/CD pipelines to ensure seamless operations 

In one year, you'll know you were successful if... 

You are fully integrated as part of the team and have built strong working relationships. 

You actively contribute to maintaining a positive, collaborative, and knowledge-sharing team atmosphere. 

You take full ownership of products and solutions, having delivered several major features to production with measurable impact. 

You share your expertise by mentoring mid-level and junior developers, helping them grow and succeed. 

You contribute to improving team processes, code quality, and technical decision-making. 

Desired Experience And Competencies 

What does it take to work for LanguageWire? 

What you'll need to bring 

Motivational and engaging with a "can do" attitude, fostering a positive team environment. 

Strong problem-solving and communication skills. 

Solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and best practices. 

Extensive experience with C# and the .NET ecosystem (.NET Core/.NET 6+, ASP.NET Web API, etc.) 

Experience with Python 

Solid understanding of RESTful API design and integration 

Familiarity with asynchronous programming and performance optimization in .NET 

Responsible for front-end codebases using Vue.js and/or TypeScript, collaborating closely with full-stack and frontend developers 

Sound understanding of frontend build tools and state management (Vuex, Pinia, or similar). 

Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD practices 

Experience with automated testing frameworks (unit, integration, and end-to-end). 

Comfortable working in agile development environments and participating in sprint planning, code reviews, and peer mentoring 

Ability to collaborate effectively in cross-functional teams, including product, design, and QA. 

DevOps experience: CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm, etc.), Docker, Kubernetes, cloud services (Azure, AWS, or GCP). 

This will make you stand out 

Knowledge of microservices architecture and event-driven systems 

Proficiency with relational databases, particularly MSSQL and/or PostgreSQL 

Hands-on experience with Entity Framework (EF Core) and LINQ 

Familiarity with message brokers (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus) 

Strong focus on testing practices (unit testing, integration testing, test automation) 

Awareness of security best practices in software development 

Ability to mentor others and foster knowledge-sharing within the team 

Our perks 

Enjoy flat hierarchies, responsibility and freedom, direct feedback, and room to stand up for your own ideas   

Internal development opportunities, ongoing support from your People Partner, and an inclusive and fun company culture   

International company with over 300 employees. Offices in Copenhagen, Aarhus, Stockholm, Varberg, London, Leuven, Lille, Paris, Munich, Hamburg, Kiev, Gdansk, Atlanta, Finland and Valencia   

We take care of our people and initiate many social get-togethers from Friday Bars a to Summer or Christmas parties. We have fun!    

150 great colleagues in the Valencia office belonging to different business departments    

Excellent location in cool and modern offices in the city center, with a great rooftop terrace and a view over the Town Hall Square   

Private health insurance   

We have a hybrid work model called FlexiWire. We offer weekly flexibility, working three days in the office and two days from home. Together with your team, you can coordinate which days to collaborate in the office.   

Working in an international environment—more than 20 different nationalities   

A dog friendly atmosphere    

Big kitchen with access to organic fruits, nuts and biscuits and coffee.   

Social area and game room (foosball table, darts, and board games)   

Bike and car parking  

About LanguageWire  

At LanguageWire, we want to wire the world together with language. Why? Because we want to help people & businesses simplify communication. We are fueled by the most advanced technology (AI) and our goal is to make customer's lives easier by simplifying their communication with any audience across the globe.   

Our values drive our behavior 

We are curious. We are trustworthy. We are caring. We are ambitious.   

At LanguageWire, we are curious and intrigued by what we don't understand. We believe relationships are based on honesty and responsibility, and being trustworthy reinforces an open, humble, and honest way of communicating. We care and respect each other personally and professionally. We encourage authentic collaboration, invite feedback, and a positive social environment. Our desire to learn, build, and share knowledge is a natural part of our corporate culture.  

Working at LanguageWire — why we like it:   

"Once the purpose & values project had been rolled out, I felt a stronger connection and more engaged. Within our team, we care for each other, help each other on tasks, projects and we value different opinions. We truly lift each other up to be our best and ambitiously strive towards constantly improving on a professional and personal level." 
(Arpi, Application Support Team Lead, Valencia)  

Yes, to diversity, equity & inclusion   

In LanguageWire, we believe diversity in gender, age, background, and culture is essential for our growth. Therefore, we are committed to creating a culture that incorporates diverse perspectives and expertise in our everyday work.  
LanguageWire's recruitment process is designed to be transparent and fair for all candidates. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply, and we ensure that candidates are provided with an equal opportunity to demonstrate their competencies and skills.  

Want to know more?   
We can't wait to meet you! So, why wait 'til tomorrow? Apply today!   
If you want to know more about LanguageWire, we encourage you to visit our website!

jobs.title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,300 customers
to provide better digital experiences to more than 18 million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.

Job Description

We are seeking a curious and versatile Cloud Infrastructure Engineer with a strong track record of deploying, integrating, and troubleshooting complex virtualization and cloud environments. As part of our VDI Lab team, you will be responsible for building and evolving the environments that our product teams rely on — standing up new VDI platforms, thin client operating systems, and cloud desktop services, and researching how to integrate emerging technologies into our infrastructure.

Because the position is highly cross-functional, the ability to communicate complex technical concepts in a clear and pragmatic way is essential. You will work side by side with product and engineering teams, and your work will become the foundation on which our endpoint capabilities are built and validated across virtualization and cloud desktop platforms.

Responsibilities

Build and evolve the virtualization environments our endpoint products run on, across the major VDI and cloud desktop platforms.
Automate it end to end: infrastructure as code, provisioning and image pipelines, so any engineer can get a working desktop on demand.
Keep it running across public cloud and on-prem — networking, identity, and monitoring.
Evaluate and integrate emerging endpoint technologies, from proof of concept to supported platform.
Work with product managers, engineering teams, and technology partners to unlock and validate new platform coverage.
Be the person other teams come to when they need to understand how a virtualization platform behaves.

Qualifications

Must have

BSc/BEng or master's in computer science, or equivalent experience
5+ years of professional cloud infrastructure experience
Deep hands-on experience with at least one major VDI/EUC platform — Citrix CVAD, Omnissa Horizon, Microsoft AVD / Windows 365, or Amazon WorkSpaces — and willingness to learn the others
Strong Windows Server and hybrid identity foundations (Active Directory, Entra ID)
A bias toward automation — Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, or whatever you've used to stop clicking through the same setup twice
English proficiency.

Where you've built depth
— we don't expect all of these; tell us which are yours

Additional VDI platforms, brokers, or gateways (NetScaler/ADC, UAG)
Hypervisor administration (vSphere/ESXi, Nutanix) and golden image lifecycle — build, optimization, patching, FSLogix
Networking for virtual desktops — VLANs, firewalling, TLS, site-to-site VPN to AWS or Azure
Cloud infrastructure on Azure or AWS, and CI/CD or image pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Packer)
Secure administration — RBAC, PIM, secrets management, vulnerability management
Thin client and endpoint management — IGEL UMS, Dell Wyse Management Suite, Intune
Synthetic testing / benchmarking — Login Enterprise (Login VSI) or similar

How you work

You can explain a platform constraint to a product manager and a design trade-off to an engineer on the same day
You're drawn to unfamiliar technology rather than wary of it — this role puts something new in front of you every quarter

Additional Information

We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers’ IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace.

With over 1000 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees ‘Nexthinkers’ and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages.

IIf you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you!  Check what we offer:

Permanent Contract and a competitive compensation package.
📍 Amazing centrally located offices near the Bernabeu Stadium.
🩺 Private Health Insurance (Sanitas) and daily meal vouchers of 11 EUR will be entirely covered by us.
🏡 Hybrid work model balancing office and remote work, with a structured approach for new hires to foster connections and onboarding.
🏖️ Flexible Hours and unlimited vacation (employees have unlimited paid time off on top of the 23 days of holidays we offer) plus 3 company-paid volunteer days.
🤸 Up to 25 EUR per month for a gym subscription.
🛴 Flexible compensation plan for childcare & public transportation.
🧑‍🏫 Reimbursement of up to 50% of the cost of English & Spanish classes.
🍉 Fresh fruit, cookies, soft drinks and protein shakes at the offie.
🍕 Regular company and team events like Pizza talks, Team Building activities, Christmas parties, hosting Meetups at the office and more!
📣 Bonuses for referring successful hires after three months of continuous employment.
🚚 We offer a relocation package to people who are coming from another country.

Please note that not all the benefits listed above are available for temporary, contract, and internship roles. To ensure you have the most up-to-date information, we recommend checking with your Recruitment Partner.

The base salary for this role is €42,000 – €70,000 gross per year, with a total on-target earnings (OTE) range of €46,000 – €77,000 including an annual performance bonus. You'll also be part of our broader total rewards package — including benefits tailored to where you live and how you work best.

We set our pay ranges using objective criteria: the scope and level of the role, the skills it takes to do it well, and the relevant market data. Ranges are reviewed every year to remain competitive and fair. We're transparent about this because we think you deserve to know what you're working towards from day one. In accordance with the EU Pay Transparency Directive (2023/970), we publish salary ranges on every Nexthink role. We won't ask what you currently earn or your previous salary. What matters to us is what this role is worth and whether it works for you. Nexthinkers come from all kinds of backgrounds, and that's what makes us stronger. We welcome applications from everyone.

Role Overview

Hiscox is expanding its use of Microsoft Dynamics 365 and the Power Platform to enhance business agility and operational efficiency across global units.

This role sits within the Group Platform Engineering team and is pivotal in delivering scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions using low/no code approaches, with a focus on Dynamics 365 and/or Power Apps Model Driven solutions.

You will work closely with solution architects, in-house teams, third party partners, and business stakeholders to help design, configure, deliver, and support robust solutions aligned to architectural principles, policies, and guidelines.

About You

You are a pragmatic and delivery-focused specialist who can translate business needs into well-structured solutions, communicating confidently with both technical and non technical stakeholders.

You’re motivated to stay current with emerging capabilities, trends, best practices, and security considerations that can improve the roadmap and team outcomes.

You enjoy collaborating with others, contributing to shared standards, and supporting capability uplift across teams and “community of practice” activities.

You are ready to act as a “go to” engineer for a functional area or product slice—without formal line management—supporting juniors through collaboration and coaching.

Key Responsibilities

Solution Delivery (D365 / Model Driven Focus)
Design, develop, and deploy solutions using Power Platform, including work that supports Dynamics 365 and/or Power Apps (Model Driven) delivery.
Translate business requirements into technical specifications and deliverables, ensuring solutions are pragmatic and maximise technology benefits.
Collaborate with the Technical Lead and solution architects to ensure solutions align with architectural principles, policies, guidelines, and the Microsoft upgrade roadmap.
Ensure alignment with design standards, reusable components, DevOps pipelines, and lifecycle management practices.
Collaborate with internal teams and Microsoft partners to ensure high-quality implementations.
Requirements & Stakeholder Collaboration
Work with business and technology stakeholders to elicit and refine requirements, shaping them into clear solution outcomes.
Communicate effectively across technical and non technical audiences to drive shared understanding and delivery progress.
Platform & Lifecycle Practices (ALM / Environments / Operability)

Support ongoing improvement of platform usage and performance, helping ensure optimal configuration and scalability.
Provide ongoing support and further development for deployed solutions.

Demonstrated experience defining, designing, developing, testing, and deploying D365 and Power Platform applications and solutions (functional specialist or developer background).

A equipa Data & AI do Grupo Ageas Portugal tem como objetivo alavancar oportunidades de negócio com dados e Inteligência Artificial, garantindo impacto estratégico através de uma abordagem segura, responsável e escalável. A equipa Data & AI procura um perfil para a função de AI Architect. Como AI Architect na Ageas Portugal, terás a oportunidade de integrar a equipa Data & AI e liderar o desenho arquitetural de soluções de Inteligência Artificial que contribuam para melhorar produtos, processos, eficiência operacional, tomada de decisão e experiência do cliente. jobs.title: Quantitative Research Platform Engineer — Founding Technical Hire
jobs.description:
AED 456,000–480,000 per annum base (approx. US$124,000–131,000), tax-free, plus 20–40% target bonus and phantom equity at 180 days

Our client is a systematic investment firm that already trades live across liquid markets on infrastructure built in-house on Google Cloud. It is now building its dedicated quantitative research and engineering team in Dubai, and this is the first hire: the engineer who owns the research platform.
A working backtesting and optimisation stack exists today. Your mandate is to turn it into a distributed research platform that can run large experimental workloads across assets, models, parameters and timeframes, with correctness, statistical validity and reproducibility built into the system rather than left to the researcher. You will work directly with the founder, shape how experiments are represented, executed and validated, and own the architecture and implementation. This is greenfield work with unusual influence over how the platform is built.
What you will build

A distributed research engine running thousands of parallel backtests and optimisation campaigns on elastic, Spot-capable GCP compute, with scheduling, retries, failure recovery, monitoring and cost control. Deterministic, versioned research datasets and a feature computation and caching layer, with ownership of point-in-time correctness, timestamps, historical universes, corporate actions and data lineage. Large-scale parameter and model search with research validity built in: walk-forward evaluation, purged and embargoed splits, strict holdouts, leakage prevention, transaction-cost sensitivity and multiple-testing-aware evaluation. A model-composition layer that moves research from single signals to composed strategies and portfolio-level simulation. And full reproducibility, with every result traceable to code, container, data, features, parameters and validation configuration, driven by a declarative strategy specification shared between research and production.
Within six months the core platform is in production use and existing research is migrating onto it. Within twelve, it is the firm's standard research environment across multiple asset classes.
Who this suits

You have personally built or materially owned infrastructure for quantitative research, backtesting, simulation or large-scale numerical experimentation, most likely at a systematic fund, proprietary or HFT trading firm, or an established crypto trading firm. You can talk in detail about a system you built, what broke as it scaled, a research result that looked right and turned out to be wrong, a measured performance improvement you delivered, and an architecture decision you owned.
You bring excellent production Python with substantial numerical and data engineering (NumPy, pandas/Polars, Arrow/Parquet or equivalents); distributed or batch compute on GCP or AWS (deep AWS experience solving equivalent problems is fully relevant); a working understanding of research correctness, from look-ahead and survivorship bias through walk-forward validation, overfitting and transaction costs; and the ability to become productive in a substantial statically typed codebase, since the backtest engine is C#. Professional C# is preferred; otherwise concrete experience extending or debugging a substantial Java or C++ codebase is required. Large-scale hyperparameter optimisation (Optuna, Ray Tune or similar) and experience designing declarative specifications that drive pipelines or experiments are strong advantages. You are willing to relocate to and work from Dubai.
This is not a DevOps, SRE, generic data-engineering or cloud-platform role, and it is not a quant researcher seat. It suits an engineer who wants to own the research platform itself.
Experience:
4–7 years
Stack:
Python · GCP (BigQuery, GCS, Batch, Vertex AI) · QuantConnect Lean (C#) · Optuna · Arrow/Parquet
Process

An initial conversation with Platinum & Partners, then three stages with the firm: a 90-minute technical deep-dive with the founder including a short C# source-reading exercise; a live working session of around 2¾ hours built around the platform you would build (no take-home, no algorithm puzzles, nothing to prepare); and a founder conversation on mission, working model and package. Offers are made within three business days of the final interview. All conversations are confidential; the firm's identity is shared once we have spoken.

Apply

Send your CV to tabby@platinumandpartners.com quoting REF 1065, or call +44 (0)203 941 9113.
